youtube_description: 睡著學英文！這部影片收錄實用「氣炸鍋」情境對話（每兩句成一組：男聲常速 ➡ 女聲慢速 ➡ 男女連貫）。場景是今晚的廚房：拆開新買的紙箱、讀完十六頁說明書、問要不要預熱、決定只噴油不倒油、第一次放薯條、中途拉出來搖一搖、時間到卻還不脆、找出原因再多烤四分鐘、第二次烤雞翅、最後洗淨內膽擦乾收好。800 句循環聽，A2 程度，零基礎也能跟著開口說。常用句型包含問做法、講時間和溫度、請對方遞東西、一起決定下一步。#英文聽力 #睡前英文 #LearnEnglish
youtube_description_en: Learn English while you sleep! This video features practical 'Cooking with an Air Fryer' phrase pairs (each pair: male normal speed → female slow speed → combined dialogue). The scene is tonight's kitchen: opening the new box, reading two pages of the manual, asking whether to preheat, deciding on one spray of oil, the first batch of fries, pulling the basket out to shake it, finding the fries not crisp yet, fixing the reason and cooking four minutes more, a second round of chicken wings, and finally washing the basket, drying it and putting everything away. 800 lines on repeat, A2 level, easy to repeat out loud even from zero.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The air fryer box is on the counter.
dialogue.phonetic: /ði ɛr ˈfraɪər bɑks ɪz ɑn ðə ˈkaʊntɚ/
dialogue.zh: 氣炸鍋的紙箱放在流理台上。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Did you bring the scissors from the drawer?
dialogue.phonetic: /dɪd ju brɪŋ ðə ˈsɪsɚz frʌm ðə drɔr/
dialogue.zh: 剪刀你有從抽屜裡拿出來嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I will cut this tape very slowly.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl kʌt ðɪs teɪp ˈvɛri ˈsloʊli/
dialogue.zh: 這條膠帶我會慢慢割開。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Careful, the cardboard edge can scratch you.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈkɛrfəl ðə ˈkɑrdˌbɔrd ɛdʒ kæn skrætʃ ju/
dialogue.zh: 小心，紙箱的邊會刮傷人。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the whole machine inside this box?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðə hoʊl məˈʃin ɪnˈsaɪd ðɪs bɑks/
dialogue.zh: 整台機器都在這個盒子裡嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, plus the basket and the cord.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs plʌs ðə ˈbæskət ænd ðə kɔrd/
dialogue.zh: 對，還有炸籃和一條電源線。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Open these flaps and look inside first.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈoʊpən ðiz flæps ænd lʊk ɪnˈsaɪd fɜrst/
dialogue.zh: 先掀開這幾片紙蓋，往裡看。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: There is soft paper under the unit.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛr ɪz sɔft ˈpeɪpɚ ˈʌndɚ ðə ˈjunɪt/
dialogue.zh: 主機下面墊著軟軟的紙。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Plastic wrap still covers the whole machine.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈplæstɪk ræp stɪl ˈkʌvɚz ðə hoʊl məˈʃin/
dialogue.zh: 整台機器還包著塑膠膜。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Peel that film off in one long piece.
dialogue.phonetic: /pil θæt fɪlm ɔf ɪn wʌn lɔŋ pis/
dialogue.zh: 把那層膜整條撕下來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This film is squeaky and hard to hold.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs fɪlm ɪz ˈskwiki ænd hɑrd tu hoʊld/
dialogue.zh: 這層膜會叫，很難抓。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Throw it in the recycle bin, not the sink.
dialogue.phonetic: /θroʊ ɪt ɪn ðə ˈrisaɪkəl bɪn nɑt ðə sɪŋk/
dialogue.zh: 丟進資源回收桶，不要丟水槽。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Lift the machine out with both hands.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɪft ðə məˈʃin aʊt wɪθ boʊθ hændz/
dialogue.zh: 用兩只手把機器抱出來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is heavier than my old coffee pot.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ɪz ˈhɛviɚ ðæn maɪ oʊld ˈkɔfi pɑt/
dialogue.zh: 它比我的舊咖啡壺還重。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Set it down gently on the table.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɛt ɪt daʊn ˈdʒɛntli ɑn ðə ˈteɪbəl/
dialogue.zh: 輕輕把它放到桌上。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Do not drop it before the first test.
dialogue.phonetic: /du nɑt drɑp ɪt bɪˈfɔr ðə fɜrst tɛst/
dialogue.zh: 還沒試煮，先別讓它掉下去。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: There is a small card on top.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛr ɪz ə smɔl kɑrd ɑn tɑp/
dialogue.zh: 上面擱著一張小卡片。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Read that quick start card out loud.
dialogue.phonetic: /rid ðæt kwɪk stɑrt kɑrd aʊt laʊd/
dialogue.zh: 把那張快速說明念出來聽聽。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where is the paper book with the rules?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛr ɪz ðə ˈpeɪpɚ bʊk wɪð ðə rulz/
dialogue.zh: 寫規則的那本小書在哪裡？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is in a clear bag by the basket.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ɪz ɪn ə klɪr bæɡ baɪ ðə ˈbæskət/
dialogue.zh: 在炸籃旁邊的透明袋裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Pull the drawer out and take the basket.
dialogue.phonetic: /pʊl ðə drɔr aʊt ænd teɪk ðə ˈbæskət/
dialogue.zh: 把抽屜拉出來，再取出炸籃。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The basket comes free with a small click.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈbæskət kʌmz fri wɪθ ə smɔl klɪk/
dialogue.zh: 炸籃咔一聲就輕輕脫開了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Why does the basket have so many holes?
dialogue.phonetic: /waɪ dʌz ðə ˈbæskət hæv soʊ ˈmɛni hoʊlz/
dialogue.zh: 炸籃為什麼有這麼多洞？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Hot air moves through those holes, I think.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑt ɛr muvz θru ðoz hoʊlz aɪ θɪŋk/
dialogue.zh: 我想熱空氣是從那些洞鑽進去的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A recipe booklet is under the paper.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ˈrɛsəpi ˈbʊklət ɪz ˈʌndɚ ðə ˈpeɪpɚ/
dialogue.zh: 紙下面還有一本食譜小冊。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The first page shows how to make fries.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə fɜrst peɪdʒ ʃoʊz haʊ tu meɪk fraɪz/
dialogue.zh: 第一頁就是在教怎麼做薯條。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This box holds the fryer and four parts.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs bɑks hoʊldz ðə ˈfraɪər ænd fɔr pɑrts/
dialogue.zh: 這個箱子裝了氣炸鍋和四個零件。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Count them again on the parts list.
dialogue.phonetic: /kaʊnt ðɛm əˈɡɛn ɑn ðə pɑrts lɪst/
dialogue.zh: 照零件清單再數一遍。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Warranty card is not inside this box.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈwɔrənti kɑrd ɪz nɑt ɪnˈsaɪd ðɪs bɑks/
dialogue.zh: 保固卡不在這個箱子裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Check the foam pocket by the inner wall.
dialogue.phonetic: /tʃɛk ðə foʊm ˈpɑkɪt baɪ ðə ˈɪnɚ wɔl/
dialogue.zh: 看看內側牆邊那個泡棉小袋。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where should we plug this long cord in?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛr ʃʊd wi plʌɡ ðɪs lɔŋ kɔrd ɪn/
dialogue.zh: 這條長電源線要插到哪裡？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Use the outlet right beside the stove.
dialogue.phonetic: /juz ði ˈaʊtlət raɪt bəˈsaɪd ðə stoʊv/
dialogue.zh: 用爐子旁邊那個插座就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That cord is shorter than I hoped.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt kɔrd ɪz ˈʃɔrtɚ ðæn aɪ hoʊpt/
dialogue.zh: 那條線比我預期的短。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then move the toaster and free the outlet.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn muv ðə ˈtoʊstɚ ænd fri ði ˈaʊtlət/
dialogue.zh: 那就把烤麵包機挪開，空出插座。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do not use an extension cord with this.
dialogue.phonetic: /du nɑt juz ən ɪkˈstɛnʃən kɔrd wɪθ ðɪs/
dialogue.zh: 這台不要另外接延長線。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The plug is too big for the strip.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə plʌɡ ɪz tu bɪɡ fɔr ðə strɪp/
dialogue.zh: 插頭太大，插不進排插。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Page two has a list of warnings.
dialogue.phonetic: /peɪdʒ tu hæz ə lɪst ʌv ˈwɔrnɪŋz/
dialogue.zh: 第二頁寫著一堆注意事項。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Read them all, even the boring ones.
dialogue.phonetic: /rid ðɛm ɔl ˈivən ðə ˈbɔrɪŋ wʌnz/
dialogue.zh: 全部讀完，連無聊的也讀。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How many watts does this machine use?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ ˈmɛni wɑts dʌz ðɪs məˈʃin juz/
dialogue.zh: 這台機器用掉多少瓦？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The label says one thousand four hundred.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈleɪbəl sɛz wʌn ˈθaʊzənd fɔr ˈhʌndrəd/
dialogue.zh: 標籤上寫一千四百。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which dial is time and which is heat?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪtʃ ˈdaɪəl ɪz taɪm ænd wɪtʃ ɪz hit/
dialogue.zh: 哪個轉鈕是時間，哪個是溫度？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Left is the time, right is the heat.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛft ɪz ðə taɪm, raɪt ɪz ðə hit/
dialogue.zh: 左邊是時間，右邊是溫度。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: These dials feel stiff on my thumb.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðiz ˈdaɪəlz fil stɪf ɑn maɪ θʌm/
dialogue.zh: 這些轉鈕有點硬，我拇指轉不太動。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Turn them firmly, then they will ease.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɜrn ðɛm ˈfɜrmli, ðɛn ðeɪ wɪl iz/
dialogue.zh: 用力轉下去，多轉幾下就會順。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Our drawer will not close flat again.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈaʊɚ drɔr wɪl nɑt kloʊz flæt əˈɡɛn/
dialogue.zh: 我們的抽屜關不平整了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Turn the basket a half inch to the left.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɜrn ðə ˈbæskət ə hæf ɪntʃ tu ðə lɛft/
dialogue.zh: 把炸籃往左轉半吋就對了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now it shuts with a happy click.
dialogue.phonetic: /naʊ ɪt ʃʌts wɪθ ə ˈhæpi klɪk/
dialogue.zh: 現在它咔一聲就關好了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That sound means the fryer is ready to run.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt saʊnd minz ðə ˈfraɪər ɪz ˈrɛdi tu rʌn/
dialogue.zh: 那個聲音就代表可以開動了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: There is a new plastic smell in here.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛr ɪz ə nu ˈplæstɪk smɛl ɪn hɪr/
dialogue.zh: 這裡有一股新塑膠的味道。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Open the kitchen window and let air move.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈoʊpən ðə ˈkɪtʃən ˈwɪndoʊ ænd lɛt ɛr muv/
dialogue.zh: 打開廚房的窗，讓空氣流通。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wipe the outside with a damp cloth.
dialogue.phonetic: /waɪp ði ˌaʊtˈsaɪd wɪθ ə dæmp klɔθ/
dialogue.zh: 用濕布擦一下外面。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wring it well, I do not want drops.
dialogue.phonetic: /rɪŋ ɪt wɛl, aɪ du nɑt wɑnt drɑps/
dialogue.zh: 布要絞乾，我不想看到水珠。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Keep water away from those back vents.
dialogue.phonetic: /kip ˈwɔtɚ əˈweɪ frʌm ðoz bæk vɛnts/
dialogue.zh: 水要離後面的散熱孔遠一點。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Understood, I will only wet the smooth shell.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˌʌndɚˈstʊd, aɪ wɪl ˈoʊnli wɛt ðə smuð ʃɛl/
dialogue.zh: 知道了，我只弄濕光滑的外殼。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Everything inside looks shiny and dark.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɛvriθɪŋ ɪnˈsaɪd lʊks ˈʃaɪni ænd dɑrk/
dialogue.zh: 裡面看起來又亮又黑。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That coating stops food from sticking, they say.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ˈkoʊtɪŋ stɑps fʊd frʌm ˈstɪkɪŋ, ðeɪ seɪ/
dialogue.zh: 他們說那層塗料會讓食物不黏。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No food yet, we finish this page first.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ fʊd jɛt, wi ˈfɪnɪʃ ðɪs peɪdʒ fɜrst/
dialogue.zh: 先不放食材，把這一頁看完。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good, I like knowing what I am doing.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd, aɪ laɪk ˈnoʊɪŋ wʌt aɪ æm ˈduɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 好，我喜歡心裡有數。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should we keep this box or recycle it?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊd wi kip ðɪs bɑks ɔr ˈrisaɪkəl ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 這個紙箱是留著還是回收？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Keep it flat, we may return the unit.
dialogue.phonetic: /kip ɪt flæt, wi meɪ rɪˈtɜrn ðə ˈjunɪt/
dialogue.zh: 壓平留著，搞不好之後還要退貨。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Manual goes in a small zip bag.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈmænjuəl ɡoʊz ɪn ə smɔl zɪp bæɡ/
dialogue.zh: 說明書放進小的夾鏈袋。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then into the drawer with the oven gloves.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn ˈɪntu ðə drɔr wɪð ðə ˈʌvən ɡlʌvz/
dialogue.zh: 再放進有隔熱手套的那個抽屜。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This chart lists temperatures in two scales.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs tʃɑrt lɪsts ˈtɛmprətʃɚz ɪn tu skeɪlz/
dialogue.zh: 這張表用了兩種溫度單位。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One side says Fahrenheit, the other Celsius.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn saɪd sɛz ˈfærənhaɪt, ði ˈʌðɚ ˈsɛlsiəs/
dialogue.zh: 一邊寫華氏，另一邊寫攝氏。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two numbers on one line confuse me.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu ˈnʌmbɚz ɑn wʌn laɪn kənˈfjuz mi/
dialogue.zh: 同一行兩個數字讓我眼花。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Follow the Fahrenheit column, it is ours.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈfɑloʊ ðə ˈfærənhaɪt ˈkɑləm, ɪt ɪz ˈaʊɚz/
dialogue.zh: 看華氏那一欄就好，那是我們用的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Pictures help more than the long words.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɪktʃɚz hɛlp mɔr ðæn ðə lɔŋ wɜrdz/
dialogue.zh: 圖片比長長的文字更有幫助。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Each photo shows one step, nothing skipped.
dialogue.phonetic: /itʃ ˈfoʊtoʊ ʃoʊz wʌn stɛp, ˈnʌθɪŋ skɪpt/
dialogue.zh: 每張照片只做一個步驟，沒有跳。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Last page is about cleaning up.
dialogue.phonetic: /læst peɪdʒ ɪz əˈbaʊt ˈklinɪŋ ʌp/
dialogue.zh: 最後一頁在講怎麼清理。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We will read that part after the fries.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi wɪl rid ðæt pɑrt ˈæftɚ ðə fraɪz/
dialogue.zh: 那一段等薯條煮好再來讀。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Page nine says to shake the basket.
dialogue.phonetic: /peɪdʒ naɪn sɛz tu ʃeɪk ðə ˈbæskət/
dialogue.zh: 第九頁要我們搖一搖炸籃。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We will test that trick with the potatoes.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi wɪl tɛst ðæt trɪk wɪð ðə pəˈteɪtoʊz/
dialogue.zh: 等馬鈴薯的時候來試這一招。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I need a special pan for this?
dialogue.phonetic: /du aɪ nid ə ˈspɛʃəl pæn fɔr ðɪs/
dialogue.zh: 我需不需要特別的烤盤？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, the basket is the only pan.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ, ðə ˈbæskət ɪz ði ˈoʊnli pæn/
dialogue.zh: 不用，炸籃就是唯一的盤。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I put foil under the fries?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn aɪ pʊt fɔɪl ˈʌndɚ ðə fraɪz/
dialogue.zh: 薯條下面可以鋪鋁箔紙嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only a small piece, never over the vents.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈoʊnli ə smɔl pis, ˈnɛvɚ ˈoʊvɚ ðə vɛnts/
dialogue.zh: 只放一小塊，不能蓋住散熱孔。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Fan blades need room behind the machine.
dialogue.phonetic: /fæn bleɪdz nid rum bɪˈhaɪnd ðə məˈʃin/
dialogue.zh: 風扇葉片後面要留空間。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Pull it back four inches from the wall.
dialogue.phonetic: /pʊl ɪt bæk fɔr ˈɪntʃɪz frʌm ðə wɔl/
dialogue.zh: 把它往後退四吋，離牆遠一點。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: There is no room left on this counter.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛr ɪz noʊ rum lɛft ɑn ðɪs ˈkaʊntɚ/
dialogue.zh: 這個流理台已經沒有位置了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Move the knife block to the sink side.
dialogue.phonetic: /muv ðə naɪf blɑk tu ðə sɪŋk saɪd/
dialogue.zh: 把刀座移到水槽那一側。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Inside the basket there is some dust.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪnˈsaɪd ðə ˈbæskət ðɛr ɪz sʌm dʌst/
dialogue.zh: 炸籃裡面有一點灰塵。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Rinse it with warm water, then dry it well.
dialogue.phonetic: /rɪns ɪt wɪθ wɔrm ˈwɔtɚ, ðɛn draɪ ɪt wɛl/
dialogue.zh: 用溫水沖一下，再徹底擦乾。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I wash the basket before first use?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊd aɪ wɑʃ ðə ˈbæskət bɪˈfɔr fɜrst juz/
dialogue.zh: 第一次用之前要洗炸籃嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, warm water and one drop of soap.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, wɔrm ˈwɔtɚ ænd wʌn drɑp ʌv soʊp/
dialogue.zh: 要，溫水加一滴洗碗精就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Every drop must go with the towel.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɛvri drɑp mʌst ɡoʊ wɪð ðə ˈtaʊəl/
dialogue.zh: 每一滴水都要用毛巾擦掉。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No wet spots left on that shiny coat.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ wɛt spɑts lɛft ɑn ðæt ˈʃaɪni koʊt/
dialogue.zh: 那層亮面不能留濕痕。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We read the whole book before cooking.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi rid ðə hoʊl bʊk bɪˈfɔr ˈkʊkɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 整本讀完才開始煮東西。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then we start with the simplest page.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn wi stɑrt wɪð ðə ˈsɪmplɪst peɪdʒ/
dialogue.zh: 然後從最簡單的那一頁起頭。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Tonight we take it very slow.
dialogue.phonetic: /təˈnaɪt wi teɪk ɪt ˈvɛri sloʊ/
dialogue.zh: 今晚我們慢慢來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One box, one manual, one calm kitchen.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn bɑks, wʌn ˈmænjuəl, wʌn kɑm ˈkɪtʃən/
dialogue.zh: 一個紙箱，一本說明，安靜的廚房。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Fold the box flat along the seam.
dialogue.phonetic: /foʊld ðə bɑks flæt əˈlɔŋ ðə sim/
dialogue.zh: 沿著接縫把紙箱壓平。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It fits under the sink once it is flat.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt fɪts ˈʌndɚ ðə sɪŋk wʌns ɪt ɪz flæt/
dialogue.zh: 壓平之後剛剛好塞進水槽下。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let me count the parts one more time.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛt mi kaʊnt ðə pɑrts wʌn mɔr taɪm/
dialogue.zh: 讓我再數一次這些零件。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Unit, basket, booklet, card, cord and plug.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈjunɪt, ˈbæskət, ˈbʊklət, kɑrd, kɔrd ænd plʌɡ/
dialogue.zh: 主機、炸籃、小冊、卡片、電源線和插頭。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Put a sticky note on page one.
dialogue.phonetic: /pʊt ə ˈstɪki noʊt ɑn peɪdʒ wʌn/
dialogue.zh: 在第一頁貼一張便利貼。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Done, so we find the fries page fast.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌn, soʊ wi faɪnd ðə fraɪz peɪdʒ fæst/
dialogue.zh: 貼好了，找薯條那頁就快多了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Only sixteen pages, and the print is small.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈoʊnli ˌsɪksˈtin ˈpeɪdʒɪz, ænd ðə prɪnt ɪz smɔl/
dialogue.zh: 只有十六頁，字還印得很小。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Get my reading glasses from the wall hook.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɛt maɪ ˈridɪŋ ˈɡlæsɪz frʌm ðə wɔl hʊk/
dialogue.zh: 把我的老花眼鏡從牆上掛勾拿下來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The manual answers the very next question.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈmænjuəl ˈænsɚz ðə ˈvɛri nɛkst ˈkwɛstʃən/
dialogue.zh: 說明書剛好回答下一個問題。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So, do we run it empty first?
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ, du wi rʌn ɪt ˈɛmpti fɜrst/
dialogue.zh: 所以我們要先空燒一次嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Back to the book, one line says preheat.
dialogue.phonetic: /bæk tu ðə bʊk, wʌn laɪn sɛz ˈpriˌhɪt/
dialogue.zh: 回到說明書，有一行寫著要預熱。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: What does preheat mean for this machine?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌt dʌz ˈpriˌhɪt min fɔr ðɪs məˈʃin/
dialogue.zh: 對這台機器來說，預熱是什麼意思？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Warm the empty basket before any food.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɔrm ði ˈɛmpti ˈbæskət bɪˈfɔr ˈɛni fʊd/
dialogue.zh: 任何食材之前，先把空炸籃熱一熱。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So the basket runs with nothing inside?
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ ðə ˈbæskət rʌnz wɪθ ˈnʌθɪŋ ɪnˈsaɪd/
dialogue.zh: 也就是說炸籃空空著運轉？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, that is exactly what preheat means.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, ðæt ɪz ɪɡˈzæktli wʌt ˈpriˌhɪt minz/
dialogue.zh: 對，預熱講的就是這件事。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: How many minutes should it warm empty?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ ˈmɛni ˈmɪnɪts ʃʊd ɪt wɔrm ˈɛmpti/
dialogue.zh: 空燒幾分鐘才夠熱？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The card says three minutes at most.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə kɑrd sɛz θri ˈmɪnɪts ət moʊst/
dialogue.zh: 卡片上寫最多三分鐘。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then set that dial to three small turns.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn sɛt ðæt ˈdaɪəl tu θri smɔl tɜrnz/
dialogue.zh: 那就把那個轉鈕轉三小格。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which temperature do we pick for warming?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪtʃ ˈtɛmprətʃɚ du wi pɪk fɔr ˈwɔrmɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 預熱要選哪個溫度？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Four hundred degrees, the highest on the dial.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɔr ˈhʌndrəd dɪˈɡriz, ðə ˈhaɪəst ɑn ðə ˈdaɪəl/
dialogue.zh: 四百度，轉鈕上最高的那一格。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is four hundred too hot for potatoes?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz fɔr ˈhʌndrəd tu hɑt fɔr pəˈteɪtoʊz/
dialogue.zh: 四百度對馬鈴薯來說太熱嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The fries page uses the same number.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə fraɪz peɪdʒ ˈjuzɪz ðə seɪm ˈnʌmbɚ/
dialogue.zh: 薯條那頁用的就是同一個數字。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Push the basket in before we start it.
dialogue.phonetic: /pʊʃ ðə ˈbæskət ɪn bɪˈfɔr wi stɑrt ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 開始之前先把炸籃推進去。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Done, now my hand goes to the dial.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌn, naʊ maɪ hænd ɡoʊz tu ðə ˈdaɪəl/
dialogue.zh: 好了，現在我的手轉到那個鈕。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Turn it and you will hear the fan.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɜrn ɪt ænd ju wɪl hɪr ðə fæn/
dialogue.zh: 轉下去你就會聽到風扇聲。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Oh, it hums like a small hair dryer.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ, ɪt hʌmz laɪk ə smɔl hɛr ˈdraɪər/
dialogue.zh: 哦，它嗡嗡的，像小小的吹風機。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A little orange light just came on.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ˈlɪtəl ˈɔrɪndʒ laɪt dʒʌst keɪm ɑn/
dialogue.zh: 一盞小橘燈剛剛亮了起來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That light means the fryer is heating now.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt laɪt minz ðə ˈfraɪər ɪz ˈhitɪŋ naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 那盞燈代表氣炸鍋正在加熱。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can warm air really come from the back?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn wɔrm ɛr ˈrɪli kʌm frʌm ðə bæk/
dialogue.zh: 後面真的會吹出熱風嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Feel it with your hand, just not too close.
dialogue.phonetic: /fil ɪt wɪð jɔr hænd, dʒʌst nɑt tu kloʊs/
dialogue.zh: 用手感受一下，不要太靠近。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It is warm, like summer wind from a window.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ɪz wɔrm, laɪk ˈsʌmɚ wɪnd frʌm ə ˈwɪndoʊ/
dialogue.zh: 是暖暖的，像窗邊吹來的夏風。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Keep the curtain away from that hot air.
dialogue.phonetic: /kip ðə ˈkɜrtən əˈweɪ frʌm ðæt hɑt ɛr/
dialogue.zh: 窗簾要離那陣熱風遠一點。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I put the fries in right now?
dialogue.phonetic: /du aɪ pʊt ðə fraɪz ɪn raɪt naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 我現在就把薯條放進去嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wait, the basket needs its three full minutes.
dialogue.phonetic: /weɪt, ðə ˈbæskət nidz ɪts θri fʊl ˈmɪnɪts/
dialogue.zh: 等一下，炸籃要熱滿三分鐘。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So we just stand here and listen?
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ wi dʒʌst stænd hɪr ænd ˈlɪsən/
dialogue.zh: 所以我們就站在這裡聽？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, three minutes is a short, quiet wait.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, θri ˈmɪnɪts ɪz ə ʃɔrt ˈkwaɪət weɪt/
dialogue.zh: 對，三分鐘只是短短的安靜等待。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does the dial count down or count up?
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌz ðə ˈdaɪəl kaʊnt daʊn ɔr kaʊnt ʌp/
dialogue.zh: 那個轉鈕是倒數還是正數？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It counts down, like an old kitchen clock.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt kaʊnts daʊn, laɪk ən oʊld ˈkɪtʃən klɑk/
dialogue.zh: 它是倒數，像舊式廚房時鐘。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Mine says three, now it shows only two.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪn sɛz θri, naʊ ɪt ʃoʊz ˈoʊnli tu/
dialogue.zh: 我這邊剛寫三，現在只剩二。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Halfway already, the hum has not changed.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈhæfˌweɪ ɔlˈrɛdi, ðə hʌm hæz nɑt tʃeɪndʒd/
dialogue.zh: 已經一半了，嗡嗡聲沒有變。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is that hum supposed to get louder?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðæt hʌm səˈpʊzd tu ɡɛt ˈlaʊdɚ/
dialogue.zh: 那個聲音會越來越大聲嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, steady is the sound we want here.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ, ˈstɛdi ɪz ðə saʊnd wi wɑnt hɪr/
dialogue.zh: 不會，穩穩的才是我們要的聲音。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should the outside get hot like that?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊd ði ˌaʊtˈsaɪd ɡɛt hɑt laɪk ðæt/
dialogue.zh: 外殼也應該變得那麼熱嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: This model stays fairly cool, page four says.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs ˈmɑdəl steɪz ˈfɜrli kul, peɪdʒ fɔr sɛz/
dialogue.zh: 這一型外殼算涼，第四頁這樣寫。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Touch the shell with my fingertip, gently.
dialogue.phonetic: /tʌtʃ ðə ʃɛl wɪð maɪ ˈfɪŋɡərtɪp ˈdʒɛntli/
dialogue.zh: 我用指尖輕輕碰一下外殼。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Warm but fine, take your hand off the vents.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɔrm bʌt faɪn, teɪk jɔr hænd ɔf ðə vɛnts/
dialogue.zh: 暖暖還好，手從散熱孔邊拿開。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where do the hot parts burn you fastest?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛr du ðə hɑt pɑrts bɜrn ju ˈfæstɪst/
dialogue.zh: 哪些地方最容易燙傷人？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The basket wall and the ring inside it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈbæskət wɔl ænd ðə rɪŋ ɪnˈsaɪd ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 炸籃的內壁還有裡面那一圈。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Get the oven gloves from our drawer now.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɛt ði ˈʌvən ɡlʌvz frʌm ˈaʊɚ drɔr naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 現在從抽屜拿出隔熱手套。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Here they are, one pair, clean and dry.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɪr ðeɪ ɑr, wʌn pɛr, klin ænd draɪ/
dialogue.zh: 在這裡，一雙，乾淨又乾爽。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One minute left on the little dial.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn ˈmɪnɪt lɛft ɑn ðə ˈlɪtəl ˈdaɪəl/
dialogue.zh: 小轉鈕上只剩一分鐘。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let us watch the last sixty seconds together.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛt ʌs wɑtʃ ðə læst ˈsɪksti ˈsɛkəndz təˈɡɛðɚ/
dialogue.zh: 我們一起看最後六十秒。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did you hear that soft double beep?
dialogue.phonetic: /dɪd ju hɪr ðæt sɔft ˈdʌbəl bip/
dialogue.zh: 你聽到那兩聲輕輕的嗶嗶嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is the end of our warm up run.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ɪz ði ɛnd ʌv ˈaʊɚ wɔrm ʌp rʌn/
dialogue.zh: 那是我們空燒結束的信號。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So the empty basket is hot already.
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ ði ˈɛmpti ˈbæskət ɪz hɑt ɔlˈrɛdi/
dialogue.zh: 所以空的炸籃已經熱了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Pull it out slowly, the handle is warm.
dialogue.phonetic: /pʊl ɪt aʊt ˈsloʊli, ðə ˈhændəl ɪz wɔrm/
dialogue.zh: 慢慢拉出來，把手是溫的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do not let that hot handle hang out.
dialogue.phonetic: /du nɑt lɛt ðæt hɑt ˈhændəl hæŋ aʊt/
dialogue.zh: 別讓那個燙燙的把手露在外面。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will slide the drawer shut with my hip.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl slaɪd ðə drɔr ʃʌt wɪð maɪ hɪp/
dialogue.zh: 我會用胯把抽屜推關。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Was that test run wasted, do you think?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌz ðæt tɛst rʌn ˈweɪstəd du ju θɪŋk/
dialogue.zh: 你覺得那次空燒是浪費嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, it burned off that new plastic smell.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ, ɪt bɜrnd ɔf ðæt nu ˈplæstɪk smɛl/
dialogue.zh: 不，它把那股新塑膠味燒掉了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The smell is gone, the kitchen smells clean.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə smɛl ɪz ɡɔn, ðə ˈkɪtʃən smɛlz klin/
dialogue.zh: 塑膠味不見了，廚房聞起來很乾淨。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Our first run taught us how it sounds.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈaʊɚ fɜrst rʌn tɔt ʌs haʊ ɪt saʊndz/
dialogue.zh: 第一次運轉讓我們聽熟它的聲音。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Some recipes skip this warm up step.
dialogue.phonetic: /sʌm ˈrɛsəpɪz skɪp ðɪs wɔrm ʌp stɛp/
dialogue.zh: 有些食譜會跳過預熱這一步。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The book says skipping makes fries less crisp.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə bʊk sɛz ˈskɪpɪŋ meɪks fraɪz lɛs krɪsp/
dialogue.zh: 書上說跳過會讓薯條比較不脆。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then we always warm it, deal?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn wi ˈɔlweɪz wɔrm ɪt, dil/
dialogue.zh: 那我們每次都先預熱，好嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Deal, one more line for our note.
dialogue.phonetic: /dil, wʌn mɔr laɪn fɔr ˈaʊɚ noʊt/
dialogue.zh: 成交，便利貼上再多加一行。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did the timer stop by itself just now?
dialogue.phonetic: /dɪd ðə ˈtaɪmɚ stɑp baɪ ɪtˈsɛlf dʒʌst naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 計時器剛剛是自己停的嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, it cuts the heat when time is up.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, ɪt kʌts ðə hit wɛn taɪm ɪz ʌp/
dialogue.zh: 對，時間一到它就自動斷熱。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is that the auto shut off they mention?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðæt ði ˈɔtoʊ ʃʌt ɔf ðeɪ ˈmɛnʃən/
dialogue.zh: 那是他們提到的自動關機嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is it, plus it stops a burnt run.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ɪz ɪt, plʌs ɪt stɑps ə bɜrnt rʌn/
dialogue.zh: 就是那個，它也能避免燒焦的一輪。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I need to unplug it each time?
dialogue.phonetic: /du aɪ nid tu ʌnˈplʌɡ ɪt itʃ taɪm/
dialogue.zh: 每次都要把插頭拔下來嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only for washing, the dial off is enough.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈoʊnli fɔr ˈwɑʃɪŋ, ðə ˈdaɪəl ɔf ɪz ɪˈnʌf/
dialogue.zh: 只有清洗時要，轉鈕關掉就夠。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let us read the preheat line once more.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛt ʌs rid ðə ˈpriˌhɪt laɪn wʌns mɔr/
dialogue.zh: 我們再把預熱那一行讀一次。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It says three minutes, no longer, no shorter.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt sɛz θri ˈmɪnɪts, noʊ ˈlɔŋɡɚ, noʊ ˈʃɔrtɚ/
dialogue.zh: 它寫三分鐘，不要更久也不要更短。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good, then I know what I did right.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd, ðɛn aɪ noʊ wʌt aɪ dɪd raɪt/
dialogue.zh: 好，那我就知道自己做對了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Next comes oil, a thin mist, not a pool.
dialogue.phonetic: /nɛkst kʌmz ɔɪl, ə θɪn mɪst, nɑt ə pul/
dialogue.zh: 接著是油，要薄薄一霧，不能一灘。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wait, is the basket still too hot to load?
dialogue.phonetic: /weɪt, ɪz ðə ˈbæskət stɪl tu hɑt tu loʊd/
dialogue.zh: 等等，炸籃還太燙不能放東西嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is fine, food likes a hot basket.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ɪz faɪn, fʊd laɪks ə hɑt ˈbæskət/
dialogue.zh: 沒關係，食材喜歡熱熱的炸籃。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I will remember that one small rule.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl rɪˈmɛmbɚ ðæt wʌn smɔl rul/
dialogue.zh: 我會記住那一條小規則。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Me too, and the shake at the middle.
dialogue.phonetic: /mi tu, ænd ðə ʃeɪk ət ðə ˈmɪdəl/
dialogue.zh: 我也是，還有中途要搖一下。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Our machine is ready, is it not?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈaʊɚ məˈʃin ɪz ˈrɛdi, ɪz ɪt nɑt/
dialogue.zh: 我們的機器準備好了，對吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ready, and my potatoes are still in the bowl.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈrɛdi, ænd maɪ pəˈteɪtoʊz ɑr stɪl ɪn ðə boʊl/
dialogue.zh: 好了，我的馬鈴薯還在碗裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Preheating took less time than I feared.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpriˌhɪtɪŋ tʊk lɛs taɪm ðæn aɪ fɪrd/
dialogue.zh: 預熱花的時間比我擔心的短。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Three quiet minutes, then the whole thing beeps.
dialogue.phonetic: /θri ˈkwaɪət ˈmɪnɪts, ðɛn ðə hoʊl θɪŋ bips/
dialogue.zh: 安靜的三分鐘，然後整台就嗶一聲。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should we warm it again before the wings?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊd wi wɔrm ɪt əˈɡɛn bɪˈfɔr ðə wɪŋz/
dialogue.zh: 烤雞翅之前還要再預熱一次嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, every batch wants that hot start.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, ˈɛvri bætʃ wɑnts ðæt hɑt stɑrt/
dialogue.zh: 要，每一批都需要那個熱熱的開始。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does the drawer need drying after that run?
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌz ðə drɔr nid ˈdraɪɪŋ ˈæftɚ ðæt rʌn/
dialogue.zh: 那次運轉之後抽屜要擦乾嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wipe it, no water before the next round.
dialogue.phonetic: /waɪp ɪt, noʊ ˈwɔtɚ bɪˈfɔr ðə nɛkst raʊnd/
dialogue.zh: 擦一下，下一輪之前不能有水。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Your dial is back to zero now.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɔr ˈdaɪəl ɪz bæk tu ˈzɪroʊ naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 你的轉鈕現在回到零了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Set it again, I want a second warm up.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɛt ɪt əˈɡɛn, aɪ wɑnt ə ˈsɛkənd wɔrm ʌp/
dialogue.zh: 再轉一次，我想再來一趟預熱。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Twice empty, is that really needed?
dialogue.phonetic: /twaɪs ˈɛmpti ɪz ðæt ˈrɪli ˈnidəd/
dialogue.zh: 空燒兩次，真的有必要嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: For a first day, I would rather be sure.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɔr ə fɜrst deɪ, aɪ wʊd ˈræðɚ bi ʃʊr/
dialogue.zh: 第一次使用的這天，我寧可確定一點。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Turn the heat to four hundred once more.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɜrn ðə hit tu fɔr ˈhʌndrəd wʌns mɔr/
dialogue.zh: 再把溫度轉回四百度。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: On, and that friendly hum starts again.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑn, ænd ðæt ˈfrɛndli hʌm stɑrts əˈɡɛn/
dialogue.zh: 開了，那友善的嗡嗡聲又響起來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: While we wait, let us check the timer dial.
dialogue.phonetic: /waɪl wi weɪt, lɛt ʌs tʃɛk ðə ˈtaɪmɚ ˈdaɪəl/
dialogue.zh: 等的時候我們來看看計時轉鈕。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It has marks every one minute, see?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt hæz mɑrks ˈɛvri wʌn ˈmɪnɪt, si/
dialogue.zh: 它每分鐘都有一點，看到了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Twelve minutes for the fries, fifteen for wings.
dialogue.phonetic: /twɛlv ˈmɪnɪts fɔr ðə fraɪz, fɪfˈtin fɔr wɪŋz/
dialogue.zh: 薯條十二分鐘，雞翅十五分鐘。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will write those two numbers on my hand.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl raɪt ðoz tu ˈnʌmbɚz ɑn maɪ hænd/
dialogue.zh: 我要把這兩個數字寫在手背上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Not on your hand, use the sticky note.
dialogue.phonetic: /nɑt ɑn jɔr hænd, juz ðə ˈstɪki noʊt/
dialogue.zh: 別寫在手上，寫在便利貼上。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Right, there it goes beside the fryer box.
dialogue.phonetic: /raɪt, ðɛr ɪt ɡoʊz bəˈsaɪd ðə ˈfraɪər bɑks/
dialogue.zh: 對，貼到氣炸鍋箱子旁邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Beep again, our second warm up is done.
dialogue.phonetic: /bip əˈɡɛn, ˈaʊɚ ˈsɛkənd wɔrm ʌp ɪz dʌn/
dialogue.zh: 又嗶一聲，第二次預熱完成了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then the basket is as hot as it gets.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn ðə ˈbæskət ɪz ɑz hɑt ɑz ɪt ɡɛts/
dialogue.zh: 那炸籃就熱到它最高度了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Careful, that handle is hot and slick.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈkɛrfəl, ðæt ˈhændəl ɪz hɑt ænd slɪk/
dialogue.zh: 小心，那個把手又燙又滑。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Use the glove, do not be brave here.
dialogue.phonetic: /juz ðə ɡlʌv, du nɑt bi breɪv hɪr/
dialogue.zh: 戴手套，這一刻別逞強。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hot basket, closed drawer, and nothing inside.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑt ˈbæskət, kloʊzd drɔr, ænd ˈnʌθɪŋ ɪnˈsaɪd/
dialogue.zh: 熱炸籃、關好的抽屜，裡面空空。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Perfect, now we talk about that oil mist.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɜrfɪkt, naʊ wi tɔk əˈbaʊt ðæt ɔɪl mɪst/
dialogue.zh: 剛剛好，現在來談那層油霧。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the oil part really that important?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðə ɔɪl pɑrt ˈrɪli ðæt ɪmˈpɔrtənt/
dialogue.zh: 噴油那一步真的那麼重要嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A little mist gives the crisp we want.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ˈlɪtəl mɪst ɡɪvz ðə krɪsp wi wɑnt/
dialogue.zh: 一點點霧就會脆成我們要的樣子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then go find that spray bottle tonight.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn ɡoʊ faɪnd ðæt spreɪ ˈbɑtəl təˈnaɪt/
dialogue.zh: 那今晚就去把噴油瓶找出來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is in the cabinet, next to the salt.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ɪz ɪn ðə ˈkæbənət, nɛkst tu ðə sɔlt/
dialogue.zh: 它在廚櫃裡，跟鹽巴放在一起。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Here is the bottle from the cabinet.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɪr ɪz ðə ˈbɑtəl frʌm ðə ˈkæbənət/
dialogue.zh: 廚櫃裡那個瓶子拿出來了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Is that the tiny one with a spray top?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðæt ðə ˈtaɪni wʌn wɪð ə spreɪ tɑp/
dialogue.zh: 是那個有噴頭的小瓶子嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It is for olive oil, thin and green.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ɪz fɔr ˈɑlɪv ɔɪl, θɪn ænd ɡrin/
dialogue.zh: 它是裝橄欖油的，細細綠綠的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Olive oil is fine for our first fries.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɑlɪv ɔɪl ɪz faɪn fɔr ˈaʊɚ fɜrst fraɪz/
dialogue.zh: 橄欖油很適合我們第一批薯條。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Fill it with a funnel, not the jug.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɪl ɪt wɪð ə ˈfʌnəl, nɑt ðə dʒʌɡ/
dialogue.zh: 用漏斗倒進去，不要用大壺。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The funnel lives in the jar by the stove.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈfʌnəl lɪvz ɪn ðə dʒɑr baɪ ðə stoʊv/
dialogue.zh: 漏斗就放在爐邊那個罐子裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do not fill it to the very top.
dialogue.phonetic: /du nɑt fɪl ɪt tu ðə ˈvɛri tɑp/
dialogue.zh: 不要把它裝到滿滿的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Leave one finger of room, then close it.
dialogue.phonetic: /liv wʌn ˈfɪŋɡɚ ʌv rum, ðɛn kloʊz ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 留一指頭的空間再蓋起來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Test the spray over the sink first.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɛst ðə spreɪ ˈoʊvɚ ðə sɪŋk fɜrst/
dialogue.zh: 先在水槽上方試噴一下。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It spits a thin line, not a mist.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt spɪts ə θɪn laɪn, nɑt ə mɪst/
dialogue.zh: 它噴出一條細線，不是霧。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hold the bottle far from the basket then.
dialogue.phonetic: /hoʊld ðə ˈbɑtəl fɑr frʌm ðə ˈbæskət ðɛn/
dialogue.zh: 那瓶身就要離炸籃遠一點。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: About one hand length away, you will see.
dialogue.phonetic: /əˈbaʊt wʌn hænd lɛŋθ əˈweɪ ju wɪl si/
dialogue.zh: 大約一個手掌的距離，你就看得出來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One short press is enough for the basket.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn ʃɔrt prɛs ɪz ɪˈnʌf fɔr ðə ˈbæskət/
dialogue.zh: 炸籃噴一下短的就很夠。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And one more press over the potato sticks.
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd wʌn mɔr prɛs ˈoʊvɚ ðə pəˈteɪtoʊ stɪks/
dialogue.zh: 馬鈴薯條上再補噴一下。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How much oil does the recipe really want?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ mʌtʃ ɔɪl dʌz ðə ˈrɛsəpɪ ˈrɪli wɑnt/
dialogue.zh: 食譜到底要多少油？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One small spoon, that is all for fries.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn smɔl spun, ðæt ɪz ɔl fɔr fraɪz/
dialogue.zh: 一小匙，薯條只要這麼多。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One spoon is tiny next to a deep pan.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn spun ɪz ˈtaɪni nɛkst tu ə dip pæn/
dialogue.zh: 一小匙跟深鍋比起來實在很少。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is why the fryer needs so little.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ɪz waɪ ðə ˈfraɪər nidz soʊ ˈlɪtəl/
dialogue.zh: 這就是氣炸鍋只用一點油的原因。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Still, dry fries come out pale and soft.
dialogue.phonetic: /stɪl, draɪ fraɪz kʌm aʊt peɪl ænd sɔft/
dialogue.zh: 不過一點油都不加的薯條又白又軟。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So we give them a light oil coat.
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ wi ɡɪv ðɛm ə laɪt ɔɪl koʊt/
dialogue.zh: 所以我們給它們一層薄薄的油衣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does the shiny coating need oil at all?
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌz ðə ˈʃaɪni ˈkoʊtɪŋ nid ɔɪl ət ɔl/
dialogue.zh: 那層亮亮的塗料需不需要油？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It needs a bit, just never a puddle.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt nidz ə bɪt, dʒʌst ˈnɛvɚ ə ˈpʌdəl/
dialogue.zh: 需要一點，但絕不能積一灘。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where exactly do the sprays go, on top?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛr ɪɡˈzæktli du ðə spreɪz ɡoʊ ɑn tɑp/
dialogue.zh: 精確來說是噴在哪裡，上面嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: On the food and on the basket walls.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑn ðə fʊd ænd ɑn ðə ˈbæskət wɔlz/
dialogue.zh: 噴在食材上，也噴在內壁上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I spray before or after shaking?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊd aɪ spreɪ bɪˈfɔr ɔr ˈæftɚ ˈʃeɪkɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 我該在搖之前噴還是搖完噴？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Spray once before, then once after the shake.
dialogue.phonetic: /spreɪ wʌns bɪˈfɔr, ðɛn wʌns ˈæftɚ ðə ʃeɪk/
dialogue.zh: 先噴一次，搖完再噴一次。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two sprays total, that is our plan.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu spreɪz ˈtoʊtəl, ðæt ɪz ˈaʊɚ plæn/
dialogue.zh: 一共兩噴，這就是我們的計畫。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Written on the note, right beside the times.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈrɪtn ɑn ðə noʊt, raɪt bəˈsaɪd ðə taɪmz/
dialogue.zh: 我寫在便利貼上，就在時間旁邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do not use that canned spray from the store.
dialogue.phonetic: /du nɑt juz ðæt kænd spreɪ frʌm ðə stɔr/
dialogue.zh: 不要使用店裡那種罐裝噴油。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The book says it eats the coating slowly.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə bʊk sɛz ɪt its ðə ˈkoʊtɪŋ ˈsloʊli/
dialogue.zh: 書上說那個會慢慢傷到塗層。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Real oil in our own bottle, then.
dialogue.phonetic: /ril ɔɪl ɪn ˈaʊɚ oʊn ˈbɑtəl ðɛn/
dialogue.zh: 那就用自己的瓶子裝真正的油。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, and keep the bottle away from heat.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, ænd kip ðə ˈbɑtəl əˈweɪ frʌm hit/
dialogue.zh: 對，瓶子要離熱源遠一點。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can every oil take this much heat?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn ˈɛvri ɔɪl teɪk ðɪs mʌtʃ hit/
dialogue.zh: 每種油都撐得住這個溫度嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Butter burns fast, so we skip it today.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈbʌtɚ bɜrnz fæst, soʊ wi skɪp ɪt təˈdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 奶油一下子就焦，所以今天不用。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What about that yellow bottle on the shelf?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌt əˈbaʊt ðæt ˈjɛloʊ ˈbɑtəl ɑn ðə ʃɛlf/
dialogue.zh: 架子上那瓶黃色的油怎麼辦？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That one is sesame, too strong for fries.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt wʌn ɪz ˈsɛsəmi, tu strɔŋ fɔr fraɪz/
dialogue.zh: 那瓶是芝麻油，味道對薯條太重。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So plain oil, and only a small spray.
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ pleɪn ɔɪl, ænd ˈoʊnli ə smɔl spreɪ/
dialogue.zh: 所以就用普通的油，只噴一下。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Plain oil lets the salt do the talking.
dialogue.phonetic: /pleɪn ɔɪl lɛts ðə sɔlt du ðə ˈtɔkɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 普通的油讓鹽巴自己說話。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My fingers are oily now, look at them.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ ˈfɪŋɡɚz ɑr ˈɔɪli naʊ, lʊk ət ðɛm/
dialogue.zh: 我的手指現在都是油，你看。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wash them, then dry them, no prints on glass.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɑʃ ðɛm, ðɛn draɪ ðɛm, noʊ prɪnts ɑn ɡlæs/
dialogue.zh: 去洗掉、擦乾，玻璃上別留指紋。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: There is a drop on the counter again.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛr ɪz ə drɑp ɑn ðə ˈkaʊntɚ əˈɡɛn/
dialogue.zh: 流理台上又滴了一滴油。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One cloth and it is gone, no mess.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn klɔθ ænd ɪt ɪz ɡɔn, noʊ mɛs/
dialogue.zh: 一條布就擦掉了，不會亂。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should the basket be wet with oil inside?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊd ðə ˈbæskət bi wɛt wɪð ɔɪl ɪnˈsaɪd/
dialogue.zh: 炸籃裡面應該抹滿油嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, a shine is all the basket wants.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ, ə ʃaɪn ɪz ɔl ðə ˈbæskət wɑnts/
dialogue.zh: 不要，炸籃只要亮亮的就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How do I keep the spray from running?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ du aɪ kip ðə spreɪ frʌm ˈrʌnɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 怎樣才讓噴的油不亂流？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Small presses, and move your hand in circles.
dialogue.phonetic: /smɔl ˈprɛsɪz, ænd muv jɔr hænd ɪn ˈsɜrkəlz/
dialogue.zh: 輕輕地按，手繞幾個小圓。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Circles over the fries, like drawing rings.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsɜrkəlz ˈoʊvɚ ðə fraɪz, laɪk ˈdrɔɪŋ rɪŋz/
dialogue.zh: 在薯條上方繞圈，像畫圓圈。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Exactly, and stop before the oil pools.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪɡˈzæktli, ænd stɑp bɪˈfɔr ði ɔɪl pulz/
dialogue.zh: 就是這樣，油要積起來就停。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do we oil the tray under the basket?
dialogue.phonetic: /du wi ɔɪl ðə treɪ ˈʌndɚ ðə ˈbæskət/
dialogue.zh: 炸籃下面的盤子也要抹油嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A quick spray, it catches the drips well.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə kwɪk spreɪ, ɪt ˈkætʃɪz ðə drɪps wɛl/
dialogue.zh: 快噴一下，它會接住滴下來的油。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: When do the sticks get their spray, then?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛn du ðə stɪks ɡɛt ðɛr spreɪ ðɛn/
dialogue.zh: 那馬鈴薯條什麼時候噴油？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: In the basket, right after the towel.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪn ðə ˈbæskət, raɪt ˈæftɚ ðə ˈtaʊəl/
dialogue.zh: 在炸籃裡，壓乾之後馬上噴。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And how much spray for one layer?
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd haʊ mʌtʃ spreɪ fɔr wʌn ˈleɪɚ/
dialogue.zh: 鋪一層要噴多少油？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Just a shine, never a wet coat.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʒʌst ə ʃaɪn, ˈnɛvɚ ə wɛt koʊt/
dialogue.zh: 只要發亮，不能濕成一片。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is salt added now or after cooking?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz sɔlt ˈædəd naʊ ɔr ˈæftɚ ˈkʊkɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 鹽是現在撒還是煮好再撒？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: After, on hot fries, the grains will stick.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈæftɚ, ɑn hɑt fraɪz, ðə ɡreɪnz wɪl stɪk/
dialogue.zh: 煮好再撒，熱薯條會黏住鹽粒。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And pepper? The book did not say.
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd ˈpɛpɚ, ðə bʊk dɪd nɑt seɪ/
dialogue.zh: 胡椒呢？說明書沒寫。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Pepper after, a tiny turn of the mill.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɛpɚ ˈæftɚ, ə ˈtaɪni tɜrn ʌv ðə mɪl/
dialogue.zh: 胡椒也最後加，磨一下就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My hand still smells like the olive bottle.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ hænd stɪl smɛlz laɪk ði ˈɑlɪv ˈbɑtəl/
dialogue.zh: 我的手還留著橄欖油瓶的味道。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nice, that means we used oil, not spilled it.
dialogue.phonetic: /naɪs, ðæt minz wi jʊzd ɔɪl, nɑt spɪld ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 很好，那是用掉油，不是灑出來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Put the bottle back on the shelf now.
dialogue.phonetic: /pʊt ðə ˈbɑtəl bæk ɑn ðə ʃɛlf naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 現在把瓶子放回架子上。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wipe the neck first, no sticky ring left.
dialogue.phonetic: /waɪp ðə nɛk fɜrst, noʊ ˈstɪki rɪŋ lɛft/
dialogue.zh: 先擦瓶口，別留黏黏的一圈。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does the spray top need cleaning too?
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌz ðə spreɪ tɑp nid ˈklinɪŋ tu/
dialogue.zh: 噴頭也要一起清嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Rinse it in warm water, once a week.
dialogue.phonetic: /rɪns ɪt ɪn wɔrm ˈwɔtɚ, wʌns ə wik/
dialogue.zh: 一週用溫水沖一次就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A spoon of oil felt so strange today.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə spun ʌv ɔɪl fɛlt soʊ streɪndʒ təˈdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 今天只用一小匙油，感覺很奇怪。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Frying in a pan would take a cup.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈfraɪɪŋ ɪn ə pæn wʊd teɪk ə kʌp/
dialogue.zh: 用鍋子炸大概要一杯油。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A cup, and then we would need a strainer.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə kʌp, ænd ðɛn wi wʊd nid ə ˈstreɪnɚ/
dialogue.zh: 一杯油，之後還得用濾網。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Here, no hot oil to carry anywhere.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɪr, noʊ hɑt ɔɪl tu ˈkæri ˈɛnɪwɛr/
dialogue.zh: 在這裡沒有熱油要端到別的地方。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And only one small thing to wash.
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd ˈoʊnli wʌn smɔl θɪŋ tə wɑʃ/
dialogue.zh: 而且只要洗一樣小東西。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Also the quiet, no big pan on the stove.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɔlsoʊ ðə ˈkwaɪət, noʊ bɪɡ pæn ɑn ðə stoʊv/
dialogue.zh: 還有安靜，爐子上不用擺大鍋。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My shoes have tiny oil dots on them.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ ʃuz hæv ˈtaɪni ɔɪl dɑts ɑn ðɛm/
dialogue.zh: 我的鞋子上有小油點。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Floor too, we will mop it after dinner.
dialogue.phonetic: /flɔr tu, wi wɪl mɑp ɪt ˈæftɚ ˈdɪnɚ/
dialogue.zh: 地板也是，吃完再拖一拖。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do we spray the basket again for wings?
dialogue.phonetic: /du wi spreɪ ðə ˈbæskət əˈɡɛn fɔr wɪŋz/
dialogue.zh: 烤雞翅時炸籃還要再噴一次嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wings give their own fat, so one spray.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪŋz ɡɪv ðɛr oʊn fæt, soʊ wʌn spreɪ/
dialogue.zh: 雞翅自己會出油，噴一下就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do the wings need a heavier oil hand?
dialogue.phonetic: /du ðə wɪŋz nid ə ˈhɛviɚ ɔɪl hænd/
dialogue.zh: 雞翅要用比較多一點的油嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A little more, their skin drinks oil fast.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ˈlɪtəl mɔr, ðɛr skɪn drɪŋks ɔɪl fæst/
dialogue.zh: 多一點點，它們的皮很會吸油。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Our oil lesson is done for tonight.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈaʊɚ ɔɪl ˈlɛsən ɪz dʌn fɔr təˈnaɪt/
dialogue.zh: 今晚關於油的功課做完了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Done, and the potatoes wait in the bowl.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌn, ænd ðə pəˈteɪtoʊz weɪt ɪn ðə boʊl/
dialogue.zh: 做完了，馬鈴薯還在碗裡等。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Shake the bottle, the oil sits low.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃeɪk ðə ˈbɑtəl, ði ɔɪl sɪts loʊ/
dialogue.zh: 搖一下瓶子，油都沉在下面。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Shake it soft, a hard shake makes bubbles.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃeɪk ɪt sɔft, ə hɑrd ʃeɪk meɪks ˈbʌbəlz/
dialogue.zh: 輕輕搖就好，大力搖會起泡泡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Why are bubbles bad for the spray?
dialogue.phonetic: /waɪ ɑr ˈbʌbəlz bæd fɔr ðə spreɪ/
dialogue.zh: 為什麼起泡泡對噴油不好？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Bubbles spray uneven, some sticks get nothing.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈbʌbəlz spreɪ ʌnˈivən, sʌm stɪks ɡɛt ˈnʌθɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 泡泡會噴得不均勻，有的薯條吃不到油。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let us try one press on the empty tray.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛt ʌs traɪ wʌn prɛs ɑn ði ˈɛmpti treɪ/
dialogue.zh: 我們先在空盤上試噴一下。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: There, a faint shine, that is one press.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛr, ə feɪt ʃaɪn, ðæt ɪz wʌn prɛs/
dialogue.zh: 看，淡淡一亮，那就是一下。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Next time I will know that shine.
dialogue.phonetic: /nɛkst taɪm aɪ wɪl noʊ ðæt ʃaɪn/
dialogue.zh: 下次我就認得那種亮了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You learned it fast, like the dial lesson.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju lɜrnd ɪt fæst, laɪk ðə ˈdaɪəl ˈlɛsən/
dialogue.zh: 你學得很快，就像學轉鈕那樣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Our hands are ready, the basket is hot.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈaʊɚ hændz ɑr ˈrɛdi, ðə ˈbæskət ɪz hɑt/
dialogue.zh: 我們的手準備好了，炸籃也熱了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: But first the board, we still must cut.
dialogue.phonetic: /bʌt fɜrst ðə bɔrd, wi stɪl mʌst kʌt/
dialogue.zh: 不過先拿砧板，我們還沒切呢。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wait, do we oil the potatoes or the basket?
dialogue.phonetic: /weɪt, du wi ɔɪl ðə pəˈteɪtoʊz ɔr ðə ˈbæskət/
dialogue.zh: 等等，是馬鈴薯抹油還是炸籃抹油？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Both get a mist, that is our small rule.
dialogue.phonetic: /boʊθ ɡɛt ə mɪst, ðæt ɪz ˈaʊɚ smɔl rul/
dialogue.zh: 兩邊都噴霧，這是我們的小規則。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A rule I can carry, thank you for that.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə rul aɪ kæn ˈkæri, θæŋk ju fɔr ðæt/
dialogue.zh: 這種規則我記得住，謝謝你。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Also the oil stays up on the high shelf.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɔlsoʊ ði ɔɪl steɪz ʌp ɑn ðə haɪ ʃɛlf/
dialogue.zh: 還有油都放在高高的架子上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The spray top is loose, it drips a bit.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə spreɪ tɑp ɪz lus, ɪt drɪps ə bɪt/
dialogue.zh: 噴頭鬆了，會滴一點下來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tighten it, then rest the bottle in a cup.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈtaɪtən ɪt, ðɛn rɛst ðə ˈbɑtəl ɪn ə kʌp/
dialogue.zh: 轉緊它，再把瓶子靠在杯子裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One last check before we start to cut.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn læst tʃɛk bɪˈfɔr wi stɑrt tu kʌt/
dialogue.zh: 開始切之前最後檢查一次。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Bottle shut, basket hot, hands washed and dry.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈbɑtəl ʃʌt, ˈbæskət hɑt, hændz wɑʃt ænd draɪ/
dialogue.zh: 瓶子關好、炸籃熱了、手也洗乾了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We did the oil, and we did it slow.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi dɪd ði ɔɪl, ænd wi dɪd ɪt sloʊ/
dialogue.zh: 噴油這一課我們慢慢做完了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Slow is good, tonight is only practice.
dialogue.phonetic: /sloʊ ɪz ɡʊd, təˈnaɪt ɪz ˈoʊnli ˈpræktɪs/
dialogue.zh: 慢很好，今晚只是練習而已。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then bring the knife, we cut them now.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn brɪŋ ðə naɪf, wi kʌt ðɛm naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 那就把刀拿來，我們現在切。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One careful slice, then the next one.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn ˈkɛrfəl slaɪs, ðɛn ðə nɛkst wʌn/
dialogue.zh: 一刀一刀慢慢切，再來下一刀。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Cut the potatoes into long thin sticks.
dialogue.phonetic: /kʌt ðə pəˈteɪtoʊz ˈɪntu lɔŋ θɪn stɪks/
dialogue.zh: 把馬鈴薯切成長長的細條。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: This board is wet, let me dry it first.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs bɔrd ɪz wɛt, lɛt mi draɪ ɪt fɜrst/
dialogue.zh: 這砧板是濕的，讓我先擦乾。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Try to make them all the same size.
dialogue.phonetic: /traɪ tu meɪk ðɛm ɔl ðə seɪm saɪz/
dialogue.zh: 盡量把它們切成一樣大。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Same size means same color, that is the rule.
dialogue.phonetic: /seɪm saɪz minz seɪm ˈkʌlɚ, ðæt ɪz ðə rul/
dialogue.zh: 大小一樣才會顏色一樣，這是規則。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My sticks are longer than the shop ones.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ stɪks ɑr ˈlɔŋɡɚ ðæn ðə ʃɑp wʌnz/
dialogue.zh: 我切的條比賣的那種長。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Long ones need room, so write that down.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɔŋ wʌnz nid rum, soʊ raɪt ðæt daʊn/
dialogue.zh: 長條要鋪得開，這一點先記下來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I soak them in cold water first?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊd aɪ soʊk ðɛm ɪn koʊld ˈwɔtɚ fɜrst/
dialogue.zh: 要先把它們泡冷水嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, ten minutes pulls the starch out.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, tɛn ˈmɪnɪts pʊlz ðə stɑrtʃ aʊt/
dialogue.zh: 要，泡十分鐘會把澱粉拉出來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The water turns white, that is the starch.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈwɔtɚ tɜrnz waɪt, ðæt ɪz ðə stɑrtʃ/
dialogue.zh: 水變白了，那就是澱粉。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Rinse them again until the water is clear.
dialogue.phonetic: /rɪns ðɛm əˈɡɛn ʌnˈtɪl ðə ˈwɔtɚ ɪz klɪr/
dialogue.zh: 再沖一次，直到水變清澈。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now dry them with the clean towel.
dialogue.phonetic: /naʊ draɪ ðɛm wɪð ðə klin ˈtaʊəl/
dialogue.zh: 現在用乾淨毛巾把它們壓乾。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wet sticks steam instead of browning.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛt stɪks stim ɪnˈstɛd ʌv ˈbraʊnɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 濕的薯條只會蒸，不會烤出焦色。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One layer only, do not pile them high.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn ˈleɪɚ ˈoʊnli, du nɑt paɪl ðɛm haɪ/
dialogue.zh: 只鋪一層，不要堆得高高的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They need air on every side, remember?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðeɪ nid ɛr ɑn ˈɛvri saɪd, rɪˈmɛmbɚ/
dialogue.zh: 它們每一面都要碰到空氣，記得嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Half the basket is full, is that right?
dialogue.phonetic: /hæf ðə ˈbæskət ɪz fʊl, ɪz ðæt raɪt/
dialogue.zh: 炸籃裝到半滿，這樣對嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, and the air can still travel.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, ænd ði ɛr kæn stɪl ˈtrævəl/
dialogue.zh: 對，空氣還繞得過去。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I add a few more sticks, just three?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn aɪ æd ə fju mɔr stɪks, dʒʌst θri/
dialogue.zh: 我可以再添幾條，就三條好嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Three more is fine, do not crowd the wall.
dialogue.phonetic: /θri mɔr ɪz faɪn, du nɑt kraʊd ðə wɔl/
dialogue.zh: 三條可以，別把內壁擠滿。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two sticks are stuck together already.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu stɪks ɑr stʌk təˈɡɛðɚ ɔlˈrɛdi/
dialogue.zh: 已經有兩條黏在一起了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Pull them apart with the tip of a fork.
dialogue.phonetic: /pʊl ðɛm əˈpɑrt wɪð ðə tɪp ʌv ə fɔrk/
dialogue.zh: 用叉子尖把它們撥開。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the basket too hot for my bare hand?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðə ˈbæskət tu hɑt fɔr maɪ bɛr hænd/
dialogue.zh: 炸籃會不會燙到我的空手？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Not bare, use the glove on the hook.
dialogue.phonetic: /nɑt bɛr, juz ðə ɡloʊv ɑn ðə hʊk/
dialogue.zh: 不要空手，用掛鉤上那副手套。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Slide the drawer in until it clicks.
dialogue.phonetic: /slaɪd ðə drɔr ɪn ʌnˈtɪl ɪt klɪks/
dialogue.zh: 把抽屜推進去，直到咔一聲。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It clicked, our first real batch is in.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt klɪkt, ˈaʊɚ fɜrst ril bætʃ ɪz ɪn/
dialogue.zh: 咔了，我們第一批真的放進去了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which number do I set for these fries?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪtʃ ˈnʌmbɚ du aɪ sɛt fɔr ðiz fraɪz/
dialogue.zh: 這些薯條要設定哪個數字？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Four hundred for heat, twelve for the time.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɔr ˈhʌndrəd fɔr hit, twɛlv fɔr ðə taɪm/
dialogue.zh: 溫度四百，時間十二。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Turn the timer to twelve, one small step.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɜrn ðə ˈtaɪmɚ tu twɛlv, wʌn smɔl stɛp/
dialogue.zh: 把計時轉到十二，小小一步。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The dial fights me, then it jumps to ten.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈdaɪəl faɪts mi, ðɛn ɪt dʒʌmps tu tɛn/
dialogue.zh: 轉鈕有點卡我，接著跳到十。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Twelve, twelve, there it sits, good.
dialogue.phonetic: /twɛlv, twɛlv, ðɪr ɪt sɪts, ɡʊd/
dialogue.zh: 十二、十二，它定了，好。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Now we wait and do not open it yet.
dialogue.phonetic: /naʊ wi weɪt ænd du nɑt ˈoʊpən ɪt jɛt/
dialogue.zh: 現在我們等，先別打開。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How long before the first peek inside?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ lɔŋ bɪˈfɔr ðə fɜrst pik ɪnˈsaɪd/
dialogue.zh: 多久可以第一次往裡看？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Six minutes, that is the middle point.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɪks ˈmɪnɪts, ðæt ɪz ðə ˈmɪdəl pɔɪnt/
dialogue.zh: 六分鐘，那是正中間的點。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Opening too soon lets the heat run out.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈoʊpənɪŋ tu sun lɛts ðə hit rʌn aʊt/
dialogue.zh: 太早打開會讓熱度跑光。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then the fries sit there and turn pale.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn ðə fraɪz sɪt ðɛr ænd tɜrn peɪl/
dialogue.zh: 那薯條就呆在那裡變白。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I can hear the fan from across the room.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ kæn hɪr ðə fæn frʌm əˈkrɔs ðə rum/
dialogue.zh: 我在房間那頭也聽得見風扇。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is working, the little light is on.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ɪz ˈwɜrkɪŋ, ðə ˈlɪtəl laɪt ɪz ɑn/
dialogue.zh: 它正在做事，小燈亮著呢。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do we stand here the whole six minutes?
dialogue.phonetic: /du wi stænd hɪr ðə hoʊl sɪks ˈmɪnɪts/
dialogue.zh: 我們要站滿這六分鐘嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, sit, the timer will call us back.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ, sɪt, ðə ˈtaɪmɚ wɪl kɔl ʌs bæk/
dialogue.zh: 不用，先坐，計時器會叫我們。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That chair, and the note where we wrote it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt tʃɛr, ænd ðə noʊt wɛr wi roʊt ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 坐那張椅子，還有我們寫的那張便利貼。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Six minutes, four hundred, one shake.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɪks ˈmɪnɪts, fɔr ˈhʌndrəd, wʌn ʃeɪk/
dialogue.zh: 六分鐘、四百度、搖一次。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One shake, I will not forget that part.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn ʃeɪk, aɪ wɪl nɑt fɚˈɡɛt ðæt pɑrt/
dialogue.zh: 搖一次這件事我不會忘。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You remembered the oil, you will remember this.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju rɪˈmɛmbɚd ði ɔɪl, ju wɪl rɪˈmɛmbɚ ðɪs/
dialogue.zh: 噴油你都記得了，這個也會。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The kitchen smells warm and toasty now.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈkɪtʃən smɛlz wɔrm ænd ˈtoʊsti naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 廚房現在有暖暖烤過的香味。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is the starch drying in hot air.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ɪz ðə stɑrtʃ ˈdraɪɪŋ ɪn hɑt ɛr/
dialogue.zh: 那是澱粉在熱氣裡變乾。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is a little smoke normal at this point?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ə ˈlɪtəl smoʊk ˈnɔrməl ət ðɪs pɔɪnt/
dialogue.zh: 這個時候有點煙正常嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A thin thread is fine, thick smoke means stop.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə θɪn θrɛd ɪz faɪn, θɪk smoʊk minz stɑp/
dialogue.zh: 細細一絲還好，濃煙就要停。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: There is a thin line near the back vent.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛr ɪz ə θɪn laɪn nɪr ðə bæk vɛnt/
dialogue.zh: 後面的散熱孔旁有一絲細煙。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Open the window a hand wide, then sit.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈoʊpən ðə ˈwɪndoʊ ə hænd waɪd, ðɛn sɪt/
dialogue.zh: 把窗子開一個手的寬度，再坐下。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oil is dropping under the basket now.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɔɪl ɪz ˈdrɑpɪŋ ˈʌndɚ ðə ˈbæskət naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 油現在滴到炸籃底下了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The tray takes it, that is its job.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə treɪ teɪks ɪt, ðæt ɪz ɪts dʒɑb/
dialogue.zh: 盤子會接住，它就是為這個。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good thing we sprayed the tray a bit.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd θɪŋ wi spreɪd ðə treɪ ə bɪt/
dialogue.zh: 幸好我們有在盤上噴一點。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, now the drips will wash right off.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, naʊ ðə drɪps wɪl wɑʃ raɪt ɔf/
dialogue.zh: 對，現在滴下的很好洗掉。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Four minutes gone, I watched the dial.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɔr ˈmɪnɪts ɡɔn, aɪ wɑtʃt ðə ˈdaɪəl/
dialogue.zh: 四分鐘過去了，我一直看轉鈕。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two more, then the middle comes to us.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu mɔr, ðɛn ðə ˈmɪdəl kʌmz tu ʌs/
dialogue.zh: 再兩分鐘，中間點就到我們面前。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The middle is when we pull it out.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈmɪdəl ɪz wɛn wi pʊl ɪt aʊt/
dialogue.zh: 中間點就是我們拉出來的時候。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: With both hands on the handle, slow and low.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪð boʊθ hændz ɑn ðə ˈhændəl, sloʊ ænd loʊ/
dialogue.zh: 兩只手扶把手，又慢又低。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Will the fries mind being turned around?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪl ðə fraɪz maɪnd ˈbiɪŋ tɜrnd əˈraʊnd/
dialogue.zh: 薯條會不會不喜歡被翻來翻去？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Shaking spreads the gold over every stick.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈʃeɪkɪŋ sprɛdz ðə ɡoʊld ˈoʊvɚ ˈɛvri stɪk/
dialogue.zh: 搖一搖會把金黃分散到每條。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let me put salt in the little bowl.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛt mi pʊt sɔlt ɪn ðə ˈlɪtəl boʊl/
dialogue.zh: 讓我先把鹽倒進小碗。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And the fork, and the note beside the plate.
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd ðə fɔrk, ænd ðə noʊt bəˈsaɪd ðə pleɪt/
dialogue.zh: 還有叉子，和盤邊那張便利貼。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two plates are waiting by the stove.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu pleɪts ɑr ˈweɪtɪŋ baɪ ðə stoʊv/
dialogue.zh: 兩個盤子在爐邊等著了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The table cloth too, tonight we eat here.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈteɪbəl klɔθ tu, təˈnaɪt wi it hɪr/
dialogue.zh: 桌布也鋪好，今晚就在這裡吃。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do we need more fries for a second round?
dialogue.phonetic: /du wi nid mɔr fraɪz fɔr ə ˈsɛkənd raʊnd/
dialogue.zh: 第二輪需要更多薯條嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, this batch is only one person's pile.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, ðɪs bætʃ ɪz ˈoʊnli wʌn ˈpɜrsənz paɪl/
dialogue.zh: 要，這一批只夠一個人的量。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then cut more sticks while this batch runs.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn kʌt mɔr stɪks waɪl ðɪs bætʃ rʌnz/
dialogue.zh: 那趁這批在煮，再切幾條。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Soak them too, the starch lesson still counts.
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊk ðɛm tu, ðə stɑrtʃ ˈlɛsən stɪl kaʊnts/
dialogue.zh: 也泡水，那一課還是算數。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The hum sounds boxed in with the drawer shut.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə hʌm saʊndz bɑkst ɪn wɪð ðə drɔr ʃʌt/
dialogue.zh: 抽屜關著時，嗡嗡聲被包在裡面。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is the sound of a closed, hot box.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ɪz ðə saʊnd ʌv ə kloʊzd hɑt bɑks/
dialogue.zh: 那就是一個關起來的熱盒子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My hands want to open it, but I sit.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ hændz wɑnt tu ˈoʊpən ɪt, bʌt aɪ sɪt/
dialogue.zh: 我的手想打開它，但我坐著。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sitting is part of cooking, strange, right?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsɪtɪŋ ɪz pɑrt ʌv ˈkʊkɪŋ, streɪndʒ, raɪt/
dialogue.zh: 坐著也是煮東西的一部分，很怪吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The clock on the wall says seven fifty.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə klɑk ɑn ðə wɔl sɛz ˈsɛvən ˈfɪfti/
dialogue.zh: 牆上的鐘指著七點五十分。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Six minutes from seven fifty, that is us.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɪks ˈmɪnɪts frʌm ˈsɛvən ˈfɪfti, ðæt ɪz ʌs/
dialogue.zh: 七點五十分加六分鐘，就是我們。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I wrote the numbers, now they boss me.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ roʊt ðə ˈnʌmbɚz, naʊ ðeɪ bɔs mi/
dialogue.zh: 數字是我寫的，現在它們管著我。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good bosses, they keep our fries honest.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd ˈbɑsɪz, ðeɪ kip ˈaʊɚ fraɪz ˈɑnɪst/
dialogue.zh: 好主管，它們讓我們的薯條老實。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The recipe photo shows deep gold sticks.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈrɛsəpɪ ˈfoʊtoʊ ʃoʊz dip ɡoʊld stɪks/
dialogue.zh: 食譜照片上是深金色的薯條。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ours will be paler, they are fresh cut.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈaʊɚz wɪl bi ˈpeɪlɚ, ðeɪ ɑr frɛʃ kʌt/
dialogue.zh: 我們這批會比較白，是新切的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Pale is not bad, it is just early.
dialogue.phonetic: /peɪl ɪz nɑt bæd, ɪt ɪz dʒʌst ˈɜrli/
dialogue.zh: 發白不是壞事，只是還早。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then we wait for the color to arrive.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn wi weɪt fɔr ðə ˈkʌlɚ tu əˈraɪv/
dialogue.zh: 那我們就等顏色上門。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you feel the warm air on your neck?
dialogue.phonetic: /du ju fil ðə wɔrm ɛr ɑn jɔr nɛk/
dialogue.zh: 你脖子那邊有感覺到熱風嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, it pulls at my hair, quite strong.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, ɪt pʊlz ət maɪ hɛr, kwaɪt strɔŋ/
dialogue.zh: 有，它在拉我的頭髮，滿強的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The middle minute is close now.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈmɪdəl ˈmɪnɪt ɪz kloʊs naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 中間那分鐘快到了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Count with me, four, five, six.
dialogue.phonetic: /kaʊnt wɪð mi, fɔr, faɪv, sɪks/
dialogue.zh: 跟著我數，四、五、六。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What exactly do I hold to pull it?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌt ɪɡˈzæktli du aɪ hoʊld tu pʊl ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 我到底要抓哪裡才拉得動？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The black handle, it stays out a bit.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə blæk ˈhændəl, ɪt steɪz aʊt ə bɪt/
dialogue.zh: 那個黑把手，它會露出一點。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Page nine said one shake at the middle.
dialogue.phonetic: /peɪdʒ naɪn sɛd wʌn ʃeɪk ət ðə ˈmɪdəl/
dialogue.zh: 第九頁說在中間搖一次。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Page nine was right about the timing.
dialogue.phonetic: /peɪdʒ naɪn wʌz raɪt əˈbaʊt ðə ˈtaɪmɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 第九頁在時間上說得對。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I will shake it side to side, softly.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl ʃeɪk ɪt saɪd tu saɪd, ˈsɔftli/
dialogue.zh: 我會左右搖，搖得輕輕的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Short shakes, not a wild wave.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃɔrt ʃeɪks, nɑt ə waɪld weɪv/
dialogue.zh: 短短幾下，不是瘋狂地甩。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The drawer handle is warm through the glove.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə drɔr ˈhændəl ɪz wɔrm θru ðə ɡlʌv/
dialogue.zh: 把手的熱已經穿過手套了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then take a second, I have the cloth.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn teɪk ə ˈsɛkənd, aɪ hæv ðə klɔθ/
dialogue.zh: 那就停一秒，我這裡有布。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The timer reads six, right at the middle.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈtaɪmɚ ridz sɪks, raɪt ət ðə ˈmɪdəl/
dialogue.zh: 計時鈕指著六，正是中間。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then this is it, our first real shake.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn ðɪs ɪz ɪt, ˈaʊɚ fɜrst ril ʃeɪk/
dialogue.zh: 那就是這一刻了，我們第一次搖。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I pull it straight out or slow?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊd aɪ pʊl ɪt streɪt aʊt ɔr sloʊ/
dialogue.zh: 我該直接拉出來還是慢慢拉？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Slow, the basket likes a gentle hand.
dialogue.phonetic: /sloʊ, ðə ˈbæskət laɪks ə ˈdʒɛntəl hænd/
dialogue.zh: 慢一點，炸籃喜歡溫柔的手。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One hand ready, the other on the tray.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn hænd ˈrɛdi, ði ˈʌðɚ ɑn ðə treɪ/
dialogue.zh: 這隻手預備好，那隻扶著盤子。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I have the tray, tell me when to pull.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ hæv ðə treɪ, tɛl mi wɛn tu pʊl/
dialogue.zh: 盤子我扶著，你幾時拉就說。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The handle is out a little, see the gap?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈhændəl ɪz aʊt ə ˈlɪtəl, si ðə ɡæp/
dialogue.zh: 把手露出一點了，看到縫隙嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I see it, wait for my nod, then go.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ si ɪt, weɪt fɔr maɪ nɑd, ðɛn ɡoʊ/
dialogue.zh: 看到了，等我點頭再拉。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ready, one, two, three, it slides free.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈrɛdi, wʌn, tu, θri, ɪt slaɪdz fri/
dialogue.zh: 預備，一、二、三，它滑出來了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Now hold it level, do not tip yet.
dialogue.phonetic: /naʊ hoʊld ɪt ˈlɛvəl, du nɑt tɪp jɛt/
dialogue.zh: 現在端平，先別傾斜。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It is level, the sticks stayed inside.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ɪz ˈlɛvəl, ðə stɪks steɪd ɪnˈsaɪd/
dialogue.zh: 它平平的，薯條都留在裡面。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Steam rose up and fogged my glasses.
dialogue.phonetic: /stim roʊz ʌp ænd fɔɡd maɪ ˈɡlæsɪz/
dialogue.zh: 蒸氣衝上來，把我的眼鏡霧化了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hold it out over the tray, not the floor.
dialogue.phonetic: /hoʊld ɪt aʊt ˈoʊvɚ ðə treɪ nɑt ðə flɔr/
dialogue.zh: 把它舉在盤子上方，不要對著地板。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Over the tray, my arms are steady enough.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈoʊvɚ ðə treɪ, maɪ ɑrmz ɑr ˈstɛdi ɪˈnʌf/
dialogue.zh: 就在盤子上方，我的手臂還算穩。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The basket feels heavier when it is full.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈbæskət filz ˈhɛviɚ wɛn ɪt ɪz fʊl/
dialogue.zh: 裝滿的炸籃拿起來更沉。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two hands, that is the safe way here.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu hændz, ðæt ɪz ðə seɪf weɪ hɪr/
dialogue.zh: 要用兩只手，這樣才安全。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: First shake, short and low, like this.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɜrst ʃeɪk, ʃɔrt ænd loʊ, laɪk ðɪs/
dialogue.zh: 第一次搖，短短低低的，就像這樣。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I saw them roll, one end is still pale.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ sɔ ðɛm roʊl, wʌn ɛnd ɪz stɪl peɪl/
dialogue.zh: 我看到它們翻滾，有一頭還是白的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Shake again, this time a tiny lift.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃeɪk əˈɡɛn, ðɪs taɪm ə ˈtaɪni lɪft/
dialogue.zh: 再搖一次，這次稍微抬一點。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Three stuck at the wall, tap them loose.
dialogue.phonetic: /θri stʌk ət ðə wɔl, tæp ðɛm lus/
dialogue.zh: 有三條黏在內壁，輕敲讓它們鬆開。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Tap the side, do not hit the coating.
dialogue.phonetic: /tæp ðə saɪd, du nɑt hɪt ðə ˈkoʊtɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 敲敲外側就好，別打到塗層。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Soft taps only, the sticks slide down now.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɔft tæps ˈoʊnli, ðə stɪks slaɪd daʊn naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 只輕輕敲，薯條現在滑下來了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did one jump out onto the counter?
dialogue.phonetic: /dɪd wʌn dʒʌmp aʊt ˈɑntu ðə ˈkaʊntɚ/
dialogue.zh: 有一條跳到流理台上了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One, right there, I will pick it up.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn, raɪt ðɛr, aɪ wɪl pɪk ɪt ʌp/
dialogue.zh: 一條，就在那裡，我撿起來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Rinse it quick, the counter is not clean.
dialogue.phonetic: /rɪns ɪt kwɪk, ðə ˈkaʊntɚ ɪz nɑt klin/
dialogue.zh: 快速沖一下，流理台不乾淨。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Back in the basket, we lost nothing else.
dialogue.phonetic: /bæk ɪn ðə ˈbæskət, wi lɔst ˈnʌθɪŋ ɛls/
dialogue.zh: 放回炸籃了，其他一條都沒少。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oil flew a little on my shirt.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɔɪl flu ə ˈlɪtəl ɑn maɪ ʃɜrt/
dialogue.zh: 油有一點噴到我的衣服上。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Small spot, the towel will take it out.
dialogue.phonetic: /smɔl spɑt, ðə ˈtaʊəl wɪl teɪk ɪt aʊt/
dialogue.zh: 小小的點，毛巾會把它吸掉。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Look, the pale sides are up now.
dialogue.phonetic: /lʊk, ðə peɪl saɪdz ɑr ʌp naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 你看，發白的那面朝上了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good, that is just what a shake gives.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd, ðæt ɪz dʒʌst wʌt ə ʃeɪk ɡɪvz/
dialogue.zh: 好，這正是搖一搖要的效果。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How long should it stay out of the heat?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ lɔŋ ʃʊd ɪt steɪ aʊt ʌv ðə hit/
dialogue.zh: 它應該離開熱度多久？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ten seconds, twenty at the most.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɛn ˈsɛkəndz, ˈtwɛnti ət ðə moʊst/
dialogue.zh: 十秒就好，最多二十秒。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Count the seconds, the fries lose heat fast.
dialogue.phonetic: /kaʊnt ðə ˈsɛkəndz, ðə fraɪz luz hit fæst/
dialogue.zh: 數著秒，薯條涼得很快。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ten, eleven, twelve, it is time to slide.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɛn, ɪˈlɛvən, twɛlv, ɪt ɪz taɪm tu slaɪd/
dialogue.zh: 十、十一、十二，該滑回去了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Slide it back until the rail clicks.
dialogue.phonetic: /slaɪd ɪt bæk ʌnˈtɪl ðə reɪl klɪks/
dialogue.zh: 把它推回去，直到滑軌咔一聲。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It clicked, the fan spun up again.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt klɪkt, ðə fæn spʌn ʌp əˈɡɛn/
dialogue.zh: 咔了，風扇又轉快了起來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did the timer keep counting while open?
dialogue.phonetic: /dɪd ðə ˈtaɪmɚ kip ˈkaʊntɪŋ waɪl ˈoʊpən/
dialogue.zh: 打開的時候計時器還在數嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, dials do not stop, they just run.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, ˈdaɪəlz du nɑt stɑp, ðeɪ dʒʌst rʌn/
dialogue.zh: 還在，轉鈕不會停，它只是走。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then we lost thirty seconds of heat.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn wi lɔst ˈθɜrdi ˈsɛkəndz ʌv hit/
dialogue.zh: 那我們少了三十秒的熱度。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Add thirty, the dial can take one turn.
dialogue.phonetic: /æd ˈθɜrdi, ðə ˈdaɪəl kæn teɪk wʌn tɜrn/
dialogue.zh: 補三十秒，轉鈕轉一下就回來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One small turn back, and it says six.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn smɔl tɜrn bæk, ænd ɪt sɛz sɪks/
dialogue.zh: 往回轉一小格，現在又指著六。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Six minutes, and the shake cost us none.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɪks ˈmɪnɪts, ænd ðə ʃeɪk kɔst ʌs nʌn/
dialogue.zh: 六分鐘，搖一下並沒有虧到。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My glove has a wet spot from the steam.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ ɡlʌv hæz ə wɛt spɑt frʌm ðə stim/
dialogue.zh: 我的手套被蒸氣弄濕了一塊。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Change gloves, a wet one slips off the handle.
dialogue.phonetic: /tʃeɪndʒ ɡlʌvz, ə wɛt wʌn slɪps ɔf ðə ˈhændəl/
dialogue.zh: 換一副吧，濕手套會從把手滑掉。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The second glove is drier, better grip.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈsɛkənd ɡlʌv ɪz ˈdraɪər, ˈbɛtər ɡrɪp/
dialogue.zh: 第二副比較乾，抓起來比較穩。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good, so this next shake stays with you.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd, soʊ ðɪs nɛkst ʃeɪk steɪz wɪð ju/
dialogue.zh: 好，那下一次搖還是交給你。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I will shake, you watch the pale ones.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl ʃeɪk, ju wɑtʃ ðə peɪl wʌnz/
dialogue.zh: 我來搖，你盯住那幾條發白的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Deal, stand ready at the front of the drawer.
dialogue.phonetic: /dil, stænd ˈrɛdi ət ðə frʌnt ʌv ðə drɔr/
dialogue.zh: 好，你站在抽屜前面預備。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The hum changed pitch when I pulled.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə hʌm tʃeɪndʒd pɪtʃ wɛn aɪ pʊld/
dialogue.zh: 我拉出來的時候嗡嗡聲變了調。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It drops when the drawer is open, normal.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt drɑps wɛn ðə drɔr ɪz ˈoʊpən, ˈnɔrməl/
dialogue.zh: 抽屜開著時它會低一點，正常。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I pulled it a second time, two taps.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ pʊld ɪt ə ˈsɛkənd taɪm, tu tæps/
dialogue.zh: 我第二次拉出來，只敲兩下。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I saw the sticks turn, all of them moved.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ sɔ ðə stɪks tɜrn, ɔl ʌv ðɛm muvd/
dialogue.zh: 我看到薯條翻了，全都動了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are the ends now the same color?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑr ði ɛndz naʊ ðə seɪm ˈkʌlɚ/
dialogue.zh: 現在每一頭的顏色一樣了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Mostly, the middle ones are still pale.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈmoʊstli, ðə ˈmɪdəl wʌnz ɑr stɪl peɪl/
dialogue.zh: 差不多了，中間那幾條還白。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should we move them with a fork now?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊd wi muv ðɛm wɪð ə fɔrk naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 現在要用叉子幫它們搬家嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, a fork will scratch the shiny coat.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ, ə fɔrk wɪl skrætʃ ðə ˈʃaɪni koʊt/
dialogue.zh: 不要，叉子會刮傷那層亮面。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So only the shake, no metal inside.
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ ˈoʊnli ðə ʃeɪk, noʊ ˈmɛtəl ɪnˈsaɪd/
dialogue.zh: 所以只能靠搖，不放金屬進去。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The book says metal eats that coat.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə bʊk sɛz ˈmɛtəl its ðæt koʊt/
dialogue.zh: 書上說金屬會吃掉那層塗料。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We shake it like a pan of rice.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi ʃeɪk ɪt laɪk ə pæn ʌv raɪs/
dialogue.zh: 我們搖它的樣子，像一鍋白飯在晃。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Small wrist, quick little waves, yes.
dialogue.phonetic: /smɔl rɪst, kwɪk ˈlɪtəl weɪvz, jɛs/
dialogue.zh: 手腕小小的，快速輕輕地晃，對了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My wrist learned it, the second shake was cleaner.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ rɪst lɜrnd ɪt, ðə ˈsɛkənd ʃeɪk wʌz ˈklinɚ/
dialogue.zh: 我的手腕學會了，第二次搖比較漂亮。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Cleaner means less oil on the counter.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈklinɚ minz lɛs ɔɪl ɑn ðə ˈkaʊntɚ/
dialogue.zh: 搖得乾淨就代表流理台上油較少。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The tray edge has three drops of oil.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə treɪ ɛdʒ hæz θri drɑps ʌv ɔɪl/
dialogue.zh: 盤子邊上有三滴油。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wipe those, then we watch the last minutes.
dialogue.phonetic: /waɪp ðoz, ðɛn wi wɑtʃ ðə læst ˈmɪnɪts/
dialogue.zh: 擦掉那些，然後我們看最後幾分鐘。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two more wipes and the cloth is dark.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu mɔr waɪps ænd ðə klɔθ ɪz dɑrk/
dialogue.zh: 再擦兩下，布就變黑了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Rinse the cloth, it is only oil.
dialogue.phonetic: /rɪns ðə klɔθ, ɪt ɪz ˈoʊnli ɔɪl/
dialogue.zh: 把布沖一下，它只是油。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The salt bowl is ready beside the plate.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə sɔlt boʊl ɪz ˈrɛdi bəˈsaɪd ðə pleɪt/
dialogue.zh: 裝鹽的小碗在盤子邊準備好了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We salt after the shake, not before.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi sɔlt ˈæftɚ ðə ʃeɪk, nɑt bɪˈfɔr/
dialogue.zh: 我們搖完再撒鹽，不是之前。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The basket sat out too long that time.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈbæskət sæt aʊt tu lɔŋ ðæt taɪm/
dialogue.zh: 那一次炸籃在外面待太久了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It cooled a bit, and so did our fries.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt kʊld ə bɪt, ænd soʊ dɪd ˈaʊɚ fraɪz/
dialogue.zh: 它涼了一點，我們的薯條也一樣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The heat came back fast after one turn.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə hit keɪm bæk fæst ˈæftɚ wʌn tɜrn/
dialogue.zh: 轉一下之後熱度很快就回來了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The light jumped on, I saw it blink.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə laɪt dʒʌmpd ɑn, aɪ sɔ ɪt blɪŋk/
dialogue.zh: 那盞燈跳亮了，我看到它閃。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Blinking means it is working hard now.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈblɪŋkɪŋ minz ɪt ɪz ˈwɜrkɪŋ hɑrd naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 閃就代表它現在很努力在工作。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then let it work, hands off the drawer.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn lɛt ɪt wɜrk, hændz ɔf ðə drɔr/
dialogue.zh: 那就讓它工作，手別碰抽屜。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My hands are off, I am sitting down.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ hændz ɑr ɔf, aɪ æm ˈsɪtɪŋ daʊn/
dialogue.zh: 我的手放開了，我坐了下來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good, the kitchen is calm, nothing burns.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd, ðə ˈkɪtʃən ɪz kɑm, ˈnʌθɪŋ bɜrnz/
dialogue.zh: 好，廚房很平靜，什麼都沒燒到。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The note says shake once, we did twice.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə noʊt sɛz ʃeɪk wʌns, wi dɪd twaɪs/
dialogue.zh: 便利貼寫搖一次，我們搖了兩次。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Twice is not wrong, the sticks looked glad.
dialogue.phonetic: /twaɪs ɪz nɑt rɔŋ, ðə stɪks lʊkt ɡlæd/
dialogue.zh: 兩次不算錯，薯條看起來比較開心。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Glad sticks, that is a new one for us.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡlæd stɪks, ðæt ɪz ə nju wʌn fɔr ʌs/
dialogue.zh: 開心的薯條，這對我們是新的說法。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Even color, that is what glad means.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈivən ˈkʌlɚ, ðæt ɪz wʌt ɡlæd minz/
dialogue.zh: 顏色均勻，那就是開心在講什麼。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One more shake, or do we leave it?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn mɔr ʃeɪk, ɔr du wi liv ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 再搖一次，還是就放著？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Leave it, one more minute is coming.
dialogue.phonetic: /liv ɪt, wʌn mɔr ˈmɪnɪt ɪz ˈkʌmɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 放著吧，還有一分鐘要到了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then hands in lap, eyes on the dial.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn hændz ɪn læp, aɪz ɑn ðə ˈdaɪəl/
dialogue.zh: 那手放腿上，眼睛看著轉鈕。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two, then one, the last turn is slow.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu, ðɛn wʌn, ðə læst tɜrn ɪz sloʊ/
dialogue.zh: 二，然後一，最後那格走得很慢。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The timer is up, the fries are done.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈtaɪmɚ ɪz ʌp, ðə fraɪz ɑr dʌn/
dialogue.zh: 計時器響了，薯條出爐了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is up, they sit in a hot basket.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ɪz ʌp, ðeɪ sɪt ɪn ə hɑt ˈbæskət/
dialogue.zh: 時間到了，薯條泡在滾熱的炸籃裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do not dump them yet, give one minute.
dialogue.phonetic: /du nɑt dʌmp ðɛm jɛt, ɡɪv wʌn ˈmɪnɪt/
dialogue.zh: 先別倒出來，再等一分鐘。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They need that minute to stop steaming.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðeɪ nid ðæt ˈmɪnɪt tu stɑp ˈstimɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 它們要那一分鐘停止冒蒸氣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Stop steaming? I thought heat makes steam.
dialogue.phonetic: /stɑp ˈstimɪŋ? aɪ θɔt hit meɪks stim/
dialogue.zh: 停止冒蒸氣？我以為熱就會有蒸氣。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Steam leaves when air moves, so open it.
dialogue.phonetic: /stim livz wɛn ɛr muvz, soʊ ˈoʊpən ɪt/
