dialogue.zh: 空氣一動蒸氣就散掉，所以打開它。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So half open now, one hand on the handle.
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ hæf ˈoʊpən naʊ, wʌn hænd ɑn ðə ˈhændəl/
dialogue.zh: 那現在開一半，一隻手放在把手上。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Like this, see the steam go to the window?
dialogue.phonetic: /laɪk ðɪs, si ðə stim ɡoʊ tu ðə ˈwɪndoʊ/
dialogue.zh: 像這樣，看到蒸氣往窗邊去了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The plate is waiting, my hand is steady.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə pleɪt ɪz ˈweɪtɪŋ, maɪ hænd ɪz ˈstɛdi/
dialogue.zh: 盤子在等著，我的手很穩。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tip it slow, let them walk, not jump.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɪp ɪt sloʊ, lɛt ðɛm wɔk, nɑt dʒʌmp/
dialogue.zh: 慢慢傾，讓它們走出來，不是跳出來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: They slid out, some landed on my thumb.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðeɪ slɪd aʊt, sʌm ˈlændɪd ɑn maɪ θʌm/
dialogue.zh: 它們滑出來了，有幾條落到我拇指上。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Hot? Blow on it, do not drop them.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑt? bloʊ ɑn ɪt, du nɑt drɑp ðɛm/
dialogue.zh: 燙嗎？吹一下，別把它們弄掉。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Fine, all safe, look at the pile.
dialogue.phonetic: /faɪn, ɔl seɪf, lʊk ət ðə paɪl/
dialogue.zh: 沒事，都在盤子上，你看那一堆。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Some are gold, some are still wet looking.
dialogue.phonetic: /sʌm ɑr ɡoʊld, sʌm ɑr stɪl wɛt ˈlʊkɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 有幾條金黃，有幾條看起來還是濕濕的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So the inside is still soft?
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ ði ɪnˈsaɪd ɪz stɪl sɔft/
dialogue.zh: 所以裡面還是軟軟的？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, one bend, they fold, not snap.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, wʌn bɛnd, ðeɪ foʊld, nɑt snæp/
dialogue.zh: 對，我折了一條，它們是彎的不是斷的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A crisp fry should snap in half.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə krɪsp fraɪ ʃʊd snæp ɪn hæf/
dialogue.zh: 脆的薯條應該會從中斷成兩段。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ours bent, and that tells us something.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈaʊɚz bɛnt, ænd ðæt tɛlz ʌs ˈsʌmθɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 我們這批是彎的，這代表有狀況。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What did the basket do wrong inside?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌt dɪd ðə ˈbæskət du rɔŋ ɪnˈsaɪd/
dialogue.zh: 炸籃裡面到底哪裡做錯了？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nothing broke, the dial ran as told.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈnʌθɪŋ broʊk, ðə ˈdaɪəl ræn æz toʊld/
dialogue.zh: 什麼都沒壞，轉鈕照著話走完了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then why do these fries look so sad?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn waɪ du ðiz fraɪz lʊk soʊ sæd/
dialogue.zh: 那為什麼這些薯條看起來這麼可憐？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They are hot, just not brown enough.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðeɪ ɑr hɑt, dʒʌst nɑt braʊn ɪˈnʌf/
dialogue.zh: 它們是熱的，只是還不夠焦。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I was sure the shake would fix color.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wʌz ʃʊr ðə ʃeɪk wʊd fɪks ˈkʌlɚ/
dialogue.zh: 我本來相信搖一搖就會有顏色。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The shake spreads heat, it cannot add it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ʃeɪk sprɛdz hit, ɪt ˈkɑnɑt æd ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 搖一搖只是分攤熱，它不能加熱。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So the shake cannot brown the fries.
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ ðə ʃeɪk ˈkɑnɑt braʊn ðə fraɪz/
dialogue.zh: 所以搖一搖不能讓薯條變焦黃。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Time and heat brown, shake only evens.
dialogue.phonetic: /taɪm ænd hit braʊn, ʃeɪk ˈoʊnli ivənz/
dialogue.zh: 是時間與溫度烤出焦色，搖只負責均勻。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Press one, it gives like soft bread.
dialogue.phonetic: /prɛs wʌn, ɪt ɡɪvz laɪk sɔft brɛd/
dialogue.zh: 按一下一條，它軟得像麵包。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No crunch at all, under my finger.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ krʌntʃ ət ɔl, ˈʌndɚ maɪ ˈfɪŋɡɚ/
dialogue.zh: 手指下面完全聽不到脆聲。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The edges are pale, the middle is damp.
dialogue.phonetic: /ði ˈɛdʒɪz ɑr peɪl, ðə ˈmɪdəl ɪz dæmp/
dialogue.zh: 邊是白的，中間是潮的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Damp means they steamed, not browned.
dialogue.phonetic: /dæmp minz ðeɪ stimd, nɑt braʊnd/
dialogue.zh: 發潮就代表它們是蒸軟的，不是烤乾的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Or the heat was not enough, hmm.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɔr ðə hit wʌz nɑt ɪˈnʌf, hʌm/
dialogue.zh: 或是熱度不夠，嗯。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The dial held four hundred, I watched it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈdaɪəl hɛld fɔr ˈhʌndrəd, aɪ wɑtʃt ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 轉鈕一直撐在四百度，我看在眼裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So heat was there, the time was not.
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ hit wʌz ðɛr, ðə taɪm wʌz nɑt/
dialogue.zh: 所以熱有，時間不夠。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Twelve minutes, the book said twelve.
dialogue.phonetic: /twɛlv ˈmɪnɪts, ðə bʊk sɛd twɛlv/
dialogue.zh: 十二分鐘，書上寫的也是十二。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The book did not know my thick cut.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə bʊk dɪd nɑt noʊ maɪ θɪk kʌt/
dialogue.zh: 書上不知道我切得厚。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Thick sticks need more time, simple math.
dialogue.phonetic: /θɪk stɪks nid mɔr taɪm, ˈsɪmpəl mæθ/
dialogue.zh: 厚的條要更多時間，很簡單的算術。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Also our basket was a little full.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɔlsoʊ ˈaʊɚ ˈbæskət wʌz ə ˈlɪtəl fʊl/
dialogue.zh: 還有我們的炸籃有一點太滿。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Full means the air had no road.
dialogue.phonetic: /fʊl minz ði ɛr hæd noʊ roʊd/
dialogue.zh: 太滿就代表空氣沒有路可走。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No road, so the middle stayed wet.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ roʊd, soʊ ðə ˈmɪdəl steɪd wɛt/
dialogue.zh: 沒有路，所以中間一直濕。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wet inside, pale outside, that is it.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛt ɪnˈsaɪd, peɪl ˌaʊtˈsaɪd, ðæt ɪz ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 裡面濕、外面白，原因就是這個。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Was it the starch we left behind?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌz ɪt ðə stɑrtʃ wi lɛft bɪˈhaɪnd/
dialogue.zh: 是我們沒洗乾淨的澱粉嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Maybe, the soak water stayed milky, remember?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈmeɪbi, ðə soʊk ˈwɔtɚ steɪd ˈmɪlki, rɪˈmɛmbɚ/
dialogue.zh: 也許吧，泡過的水還是乳白的，記得嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then the starch held the fries together.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn ðə stɑrtʃ hɛld ðə fraɪz təˈɡɛðɚ/
dialogue.zh: 那澱粉就把薯條粘成一團。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Clumps do not brown, we learned tonight.
dialogue.phonetic: /klʌmps du nɑt braʊn, wi lɜrnd təˈnaɪt/
dialogue.zh: 一團團不會焦，我們今晚學會了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One more try, or do we eat now?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn mɔr traɪ, ɔr du wi it naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 再試一次，還是現在就吃？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let us try four minutes, then decide.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛt ʌs traɪ fɔr ˈmɪnɪts, ðɛn dɪˈsaɪd/
dialogue.zh: 我們再試四分鐘，然後決定。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Put them back, all of them, careful.
dialogue.phonetic: /pʊt ðɛm bæk, ɔl ʌv ðɛm, ˈkɛrfəl/
dialogue.zh: 把它們全部放回炸籃，小心。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, only half, spread them wide.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ, ˈoʊnli hæf, sprɛd ðɛm waɪd/
dialogue.zh: 不，只放一半，攤得開開的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Half is wiser, air gets a road.
dialogue.phonetic: /hæf ɪz ˈwaɪzɚ, ɛr ɡɛts ə roʊd/
dialogue.zh: 放一半比較聰明，空氣就有路。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Slide it in, and turn four more.
dialogue.phonetic: /slaɪd ɪt ɪn, ænd tɜrn fɔr mɔr/
dialogue.zh: 推進去，再轉四分鐘。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The dial took the extra turn fine.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈdaɪəl tʊk ði ˈɛkstrə tɜrn faɪn/
dialogue.zh: 轉鈕很輕鬆就吞下多出來的那格。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Now we sit again, four minutes more.
dialogue.phonetic: /naʊ wi sɪt əˈɡɛn, fɔr ˈmɪnɪts mɔr/
dialogue.zh: 現在我們又坐下，再多四分鐘。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This wait feels different, I am not upset.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs weɪt filz ˈdɪfɚənt, aɪ æm nɑt ʌpˈsɛt/
dialogue.zh: 這次的等待不一樣，我不煩躁。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Me neither, we know what it is doing.
dialogue.phonetic: /mi niˈðɚ, wi noʊ wʌt ɪt ɪz ˈduɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 我也是，我們知道它在做什麼。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The hum is lower this second time.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə hʌm ɪz ˈloʊɚ ðɪs ˈsɛkənd taɪm/
dialogue.zh: 第二次這個嗡嗡聲比較低。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Lower hum, still hot, do not worry.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈloʊɚ hʌm, stɪl hɑt, du nɑt ˈwɜri/
dialogue.zh: 聲音低也還在熱，別擔心。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The smell moved from toast to sugar.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə smɛl muvd frʌm toʊst tu ˈʃʊɡɚ/
dialogue.zh: 味道從烤吐司變成糖了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is real sugar in the potato, good.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ɪz ril ˈʃʊɡɚ ɪn ðə pəˈteɪtoʊ, ɡʊd/
dialogue.zh: 那是馬鈴薯裡真正的糖，是好事。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sugar means color is on its way.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈʃʊɡɚ minz ˈkʌlɚ ɪz ɑn ɪts weɪ/
dialogue.zh: 有糖就代表顏色正在路上。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I see gold at the corner, yes.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ si ɡoʊld ət ðə ˈkɔrnɚ, jɛs/
dialogue.zh: 我看到角落有金黃了，是的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The timer rang, let us look close.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈtaɪmɚ ræŋ, lɛt ʌs lʊk kloʊs/
dialogue.zh: 計時器響了，我們湊近看看。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Hold the tray, tilt the basket here.
dialogue.phonetic: /hoʊld ðə treɪ, tɪlt ðə ˈbæskət hɪr/
dialogue.zh: 你扶盤子，把炸籃傾到這邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Look, some of them did brown.
dialogue.phonetic: /lʊk, sʌm ʌv ðɛm dɪd braʊn/
dialogue.zh: 你看，有一部分真的焦了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Not all, but enough to try again.
dialogue.phonetic: /nɑt ɔl, bʌt ɪˈnʌf tu traɪ əˈɡɛn/
dialogue.zh: 不是全部，但夠我們再試一次。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Press one now, does it snap?
dialogue.phonetic: /prɛs wʌn naʊ, dʌz ɪt snæp/
dialogue.zh: 現在按一條，它會斷嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It cracked, I heard a small crack.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt krækt, aɪ hɜrd ə smɔl kræk/
dialogue.zh: 它裂開了，我聽到小小的一聲裂。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Crack is our yes word tonight.
dialogue.phonetic: /kræk ɪz ˈaʊɚ jɛs wɜrd təˈnaɪt/
dialogue.zh: 裂聲就是我們今晚的好。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then we are done, pass me the salt.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn wi ɑr dʌn, pæs mi ðə sɔlt/
dialogue.zh: 那我們就完工了，把鹽遞給我。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The salt grains sit on top, dry.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə sɔlt ɡreɪnz sɪt ɑn tɑp, draɪ/
dialogue.zh: 鹽粒乾乾地停在最上面。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: On damp fries they sink and vanish.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑn dæmp fraɪz ðeɪ sɪŋk ænd ˈvænɪʃ/
dialogue.zh: 在潮的薯條上它們沉下去就不見。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So salt at the very last minute.
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ sɔlt ət ðə ˈvɛri læst ˈmɪnɪt/
dialogue.zh: 所以鹽要最後一分鐘才撒。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And eat them now, while the gold is hot.
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd it ðɛm naʊ, waɪl ðə ɡoʊld ɪz hɑt/
dialogue.zh: 現在就吃，趁金黃還燙。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One bite, hmm, inside is fluffy.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn baɪt, hʌm, ɪnˈsaɪd ɪz ˈflʌfi/
dialogue.zh: 咬一口，嗯，裡面是鬆的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Fluffy in, crisp on, that is our win.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈflʌfi ɪn, krɪsp ɑn, ðæt ɪz ˈaʊɚ wɪn/
dialogue.zh: 外脆內鬆，這就是我們的勝利。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Not every stick, but many are good.
dialogue.phonetic: /nɑt ˈɛvri stɪk, bʌt ˈmɛni ɑr ɡʊd/
dialogue.zh: 不是每一條，但很多很好。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good enough for tonight, truly ours.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd ɪˈnʌf fɔr təˈnaɪt, ˈtruli ˈaʊɚz/
dialogue.zh: 對今晚來說已經夠好，真的是我們做的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The rest we leave, no third round.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə rɛst wi liv, noʊ θɜrd raʊnd/
dialogue.zh: 剩下的我們就不管，不再有第三輪。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Agreed, two rounds are plenty tonight.
dialogue.phonetic: /əˈɡrid, tu raʊndz ɑr ˈplɛnti təˈnaɪt/
dialogue.zh: 同意，兩輪對今晚已經很多了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My first air fryer fries are eaten.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ fɜrst ɛr ˈfraɪər fraɪz ɑr ˈɪtən/
dialogue.zh: 我人生第一盤氣炸鍋薯條吃完了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Half on your plate, half still warm.
dialogue.phonetic: /hæf ɑn jɔr pleɪt, hæf stɪl wɔrm/
dialogue.zh: 一半在你盤裡，一半還溫熱。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Write what we learned on the note.
dialogue.phonetic: /raɪt wʌt wi lɜrnd ɑn ðə noʊt/
dialogue.zh: 把我們學到的寫在便利貼上。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Drier, thinner, one layer, four extra.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈdraɪər, ˈθɪnɚ, wʌn ˈleɪɚ, fɔr ˈɛkstrə/
dialogue.zh: 更乾、更薄、一層、多四分鐘。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The booklet now has our small marks.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈbʊklət naʊ hæz ˈaʊɚ smɔl mɑrks/
dialogue.zh: 那本小冊現在有我們的小記號。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Pencil lines beside the fries page.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɛnsəl laɪnz bəˈsaɪd ðə fraɪz peɪdʒ/
dialogue.zh: 鉛筆線畫在薯條那頁旁邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Pencil, not pen, the book is shared.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɛnsəl, nɑt pɛn, ðə bʊk ɪz ʃɛrd/
dialogue.zh: 用鉛筆不用原子筆，這本書是共用的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Right, next time we can change it.
dialogue.phonetic: /raɪt, nɛkst taɪm wi kæn tʃeɪndʒ ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 對，下次我們還可以改。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Next time we start earlier in the evening.
dialogue.phonetic: /nɛkst taɪm wi stɑrt ˈɜrliər ɪn ði ˈivnɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 下次我們要在傍晚早一點開始。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, before I am too hungry.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, bɪˈfɔr aɪ æm tu ˈhʌŋɡri/
dialogue.zh: 好，在我餓過頭之前。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Being hungry made me rush the dial.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈbiɪŋ ˈhʌŋɡri meɪd mi rʌʃ ðə ˈdaɪəl/
dialogue.zh: 餓著讓我急著轉鈕。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Rushing costs minutes, we saw that.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈrʌʃɪŋ kɔsts ˈmɪnɪts, wi sɔ ðæt/
dialogue.zh: 心急會多花幾分鐘，我們看到了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The frozen ones would be faster.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈfroʊzən wʌnz wʊd bi ˈfæstɚ/
dialogue.zh: 冷凍的那種會快一點。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Maybe, but fresh taught us more.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈmeɪbi, bʌt frɛʃ tɔt ʌs mɔr/
dialogue.zh: 也許，但新鮮的教我們更多。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Fresh needs a dry towel, always.
dialogue.phonetic: /frɛʃ nidz ə draɪ ˈtaʊəl, ˈɔlweɪz/
dialogue.zh: 新鮮的永遠需要一條乾毛巾。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And a wide basket, never crowded.
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd ə waɪd ˈbæskət, ˈnɛvɚ ˈkraʊdɪd/
dialogue.zh: 還要有寬的炸籃，不能擠。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Our tray caught oil, is it dry?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈaʊɚ treɪ kɔt ɔɪl, ɪz ɪt draɪ/
dialogue.zh: 我們的盤子接到了油，它乾了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The tray is dry, I wiped it twice.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə treɪ ɪz draɪ, aɪ waɪpt ɪt twaɪs/
dialogue.zh: 盤子乾了，我擦過兩遍。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Salt on the plate, or in the bowl?
dialogue.phonetic: /sɔlt ɑn ðə pleɪt, ɔr ɪn ðə boʊl/
dialogue.zh: 鹽要撒在盤上還是碗裡？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: In the bowl, so we each choose.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪn ðə boʊl, soʊ wi itʃ tʃuz/
dialogue.zh: 在碗裡，這樣各自決定。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I choose a little, you like more.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ tʃuz ə ˈlɪtəl, ju laɪk mɔr/
dialogue.zh: 我選少量，你喜歡多一點。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: More for me, with pepper too.
dialogue.phonetic: /mɔr fɔr mi, wɪð ˈpɛpɚ tu/
dialogue.zh: 給我多一點，還要加胡椒。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Pepper on warm fries smells bright.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɛpɚ ɑn wɔrm fraɪz smɛlz braɪt/
dialogue.zh: 胡椒撒在溫熱薯條上聞起來很亮。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Bright, and the kitchen is calm now.
dialogue.phonetic: /braɪt, ænd ðə ˈkɪtʃən ɪz kɑm naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 亮亮的，而且廚房現在很安靜。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Calm kitchen, one dirty basket to wash.
dialogue.phonetic: /kɑm ˈkɪtʃən, wʌn ˈdɜrti ˈbæskət tu wɑʃ/
dialogue.zh: 安靜的廚房，一個髒炸籃等著洗。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is for later, sit and eat.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ɪz fɔr ˈleɪtɚ, sɪt ænd it/
dialogue.zh: 那個等一下，先坐下吃。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Later we clean, tonight we taste.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈleɪtɚ wi klin, təˈnaɪt wi teɪst/
dialogue.zh: 等等再清理，今晚先嚐味道。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Taste first, then the sponge, always.
dialogue.phonetic: /teɪst fɜrst, ðɛn ðə spʌndʒ, ˈɔlweɪz/
dialogue.zh: 先嚐，再來是海綿，永遠如此。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The wings are next, are they ready?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə wɪŋz ɑr nɛkst, ɑr ðeɪ ˈrɛdi/
dialogue.zh: 雞翅是下一站，它們準備好了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The wings wait in the fridge, cold.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə wɪŋz weɪt ɪn ðə frɪdʒ, koʊld/
dialogue.zh: 雞翅在冰箱裡等，冷冷的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Cold wings need more minutes, page ten?
dialogue.phonetic: /koʊld wɪŋz nid mɔr ˈmɪnɪts, peɪdʒ tɛn/
dialogue.zh: 冰的雞翅要更多分鐘，第十頁？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Page ten says eighteen, with a flip.
dialogue.phonetic: /peɪdʒ tɛn sɛz ˌeɪˈtin, wɪð ə flɪp/
dialogue.zh: 第十頁寫十八分鐘，還要翻一次。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Flip means turn each one, not shake.
dialogue.phonetic: /flɪp minz tɜrn itʃ wʌn, nɑt ʃeɪk/
dialogue.zh: 翻面是把每隻翻過來，不是搖。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You understand the machine, in one night.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju ˌʊndɚˈstænd ðə məˈʃin, ɪn wʌn naɪt/
dialogue.zh: 你在一晚之間就懂這台機器了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One night, from box to hot basket.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn naɪt, frʌm bɑks tu hɑt ˈbæskət/
dialogue.zh: 一晚，從紙箱到滾熱的炸籃。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And the pale fries taught us best.
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd ðə peɪl fraɪz tɔt ʌs bɛst/
dialogue.zh: 是那些發白的薯條教得最好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Pale fries are our small teacher.
dialogue.phonetic: /peɪl fraɪz ɑr ˈaʊɚ smɔl ˈtitʃɚ/
dialogue.zh: 白薯條是我們的小老師。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Thank you, pale teacher, we listened.
dialogue.phonetic: /θæŋk ju, peɪl ˈtitʃɚ, wi ˈlɪsənd/
dialogue.zh: 謝謝你，小白老師，我們有聽。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Next batch will be thinner, watch me.
dialogue.phonetic: /nɛkst bætʃ wɪl bi ˈθɪnɚ, wɑtʃ mi/
dialogue.zh: 下一批會切更薄，你看著。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will watch, and count the turns.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl wɑtʃ, ænd kaʊnt ðə tɜrnz/
dialogue.zh: 我會看著，也數著轉的格數。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Count the turns, do not count worry.
dialogue.phonetic: /kaʊnt ðə tɜrnz, du nɑt kaʊnt ˈwɜri/
dialogue.zh: 數轉鈕的格數，不要數擔憂。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Worry is gone, the light is on.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈwɜri ɪz ɡɔn, ðə laɪt ɪz ɑn/
dialogue.zh: 擔憂不見了，小燈還亮著。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The light means heat, the clock means late.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə laɪt minz hit, ðə klɑk minz leɪt/
dialogue.zh: 小燈代表熱，時鐘代表晚了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Soon then, finish the wings, then rest.
dialogue.phonetic: /sun ðɛn, ˈfɪnɪʃ ðə wɪŋz, ðɛn rɛst/
dialogue.zh: 那快了，把雞翅烤完就休息。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wings after this, the plate is empty.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪŋz ˈæftɚ ðɪs, ðə pleɪt ɪz ˈɛmpti/
dialogue.zh: 接著輪到雞翅，盤子已經空了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Empty plate, full basket of lessons.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɛmpti pleɪt, fʊl ˈbæskət ʌv ˈlɛsənz/
dialogue.zh: 盤子空了，炸籃裝滿功課。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let us stand, the wings need hands.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛt ʌs stænd, ðə wɪŋz nid hændz/
dialogue.zh: 我們站起來吧，雞翅需要手。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, wash hands, then dry each wing.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, wɑʃ hændz, ðɛn draɪ itʃ wɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 好，先洗手，再把每一隻擦乾。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Our wings came cold and firm.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈaʊɚ wɪŋz keɪm koʊld ænd fɜrm/
dialogue.zh: 我們的雞翅冰冰的，肉很結實。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Eight of them, in a white foam tray.
dialogue.phonetic: /eɪt ʌv ðɛm, ɪn ə waɪt foʊm treɪ/
dialogue.zh: 八隻，裝在白色保麗龍盤裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Count them twice, I want to be sure.
dialogue.phonetic: /kaʊnt ðɛm twaɪs, aɪ wɑnt tu bi ʃʊr/
dialogue.zh: 數兩次，我想確定。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Eight, two plates, four wings each.
dialogue.phonetic: /eɪt, tu pleɪts, fɔr wɪŋz itʃ/
dialogue.zh: 八隻，兩個盤，一人四隻。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Dry every wing with paper first.
dialogue.phonetic: /draɪ ˈɛvri wɪŋ wɪð ˈpeɪpɚ fɜrst/
dialogue.zh: 先用紙巾把每一隻擦乾。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Dry skin bubbles, wet skin only steams.
dialogue.phonetic: /draɪ skɪn ˈbʌbəlz, wɛt skɪn ˈoʊnli stimz/
dialogue.zh: 乾皮會起泡，濕皮只有蒸氣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Pat them, do not rub, the skin is thin.
dialogue.phonetic: /pæt ðɛm, du nɑt rʌb, ðə skɪn ɪz θɪn/
dialogue.zh: 按一按就好，別擦破，皮很薄。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Patting done, they feel rough and dry.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpætɪŋ dʌn, ðeɪ fil rʌf ænd draɪ/
dialogue.zh: 按完了，摸起來粗粗乾乾的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which spices did the wing page list?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪtʃ ˈspaɪsəz dɪd ðə wɪŋ peɪdʒ lɪst/
dialogue.zh: 雞翅那一頁列了哪些香料？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Salt, paprika, and garlic powder.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɔlt, pəˈprikə, ænd ˈɡɑrlɪk ˈpaʊdɚ/
dialogue.zh: 鹽、紅椒粉，還有大蒜粉。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Paprika gives color, not much heat.
dialogue.phonetic: /pəˈprikə ɡɪvz ˈkʌlɚ, nɑt mʌtʃ hit/
dialogue.zh: 紅椒粉給顏色，不太給辣度。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We want red skin, so one small spoon.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi wɑnt rɛd skɪn, soʊ wʌn smɔl spun/
dialogue.zh: 我們要紅紅的皮，所以一小匙。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Garlic powder on both sides, lightly.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɡɑrlɪk ˈpaʊdɚ ɑn boʊθ saɪdz, ˈlaɪtli/
dialogue.zh: 兩面都撒大蒜粉，輕輕撒。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And salt last, or the wings weep.
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd sɔlt læst, ɔr ðə wɪŋz wip/
dialogue.zh: 鹽最後才放，否則雞翅會出水。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now a spray of oil on pale skin.
dialogue.phonetic: /naʊ ə spreɪ ʌv ɔɪl ɑn peɪl skɪn/
dialogue.zh: 現在對著白的雞皮噴一下油。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One press, the skin already shines.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn prɛs, ðə skɪn ɔlˈrɛdi ʃaɪnz/
dialogue.zh: 按一次，雞皮已經發亮了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Preheat once more, three minutes, empty.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpriˌhɪt wʌns mɔr, θri ˈmɪnɪts, ˈɛmpti/
dialogue.zh: 再預熱一次，三分鐘，空著。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: While it warms, I line up the tray.
dialogue.phonetic: /waɪl ɪt wɔrmz, aɪ laɪn ʌp ðə treɪ/
dialogue.zh: 它熱的時候，我把盤子排好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Its light blinked, the machine is ready.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪts laɪt blɪŋkt, ðə məˈʃin ɪz ˈrɛdi/
dialogue.zh: 它的燈閃了一下，機器準備好了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Skin side down, in one single row.
dialogue.phonetic: /skɪn saɪd daʊn, ɪn wʌn ˈsɪŋɡəl roʊ/
dialogue.zh: 雞皮朝下，排成一列。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are the gaps wide enough between wings?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑr ðə ɡæps waɪd ɪˈnʌf bɪˈtwin wɪŋz/
dialogue.zh: 雞翅中間的縫夠寬嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One finger fits, that is enough room.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn ˈfɪŋɡɚ fɪts, ðæt ɪz ɪˈnʌf rum/
dialogue.zh: 一根手指放得進去，空間夠了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: All eight fit flat, nothing stacked.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɔl eɪt fɪt flæt, ˈnʌθɪŋ stækt/
dialogue.zh: 八隻全部平放，沒有疊起來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then one run holds all of them.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn wʌn rʌn hoʊldz ɔl ʌv ðɛm/
dialogue.zh: 那我們一鍋就能全烤完。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Heat at four hundred, drawer clicks shut.
dialogue.phonetic: /hit æt fɔr ˈhʌndrəd, drɔr klɪks ʃʌt/
dialogue.zh: 溫度設四百，抽屜咔一聲關好。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Eighteen minutes, and we sit down.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˌeɪˈtin ˈmɪnɪts, ænd wi sɪt daʊn/
dialogue.zh: 十八分鐘，然後我們坐下。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Eighteen feels long after twelve.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˌeɪˈtin filz lɔŋ ˈæftɚ twɛlv/
dialogue.zh: 十八分鐘比十二分鐘感覺長。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wings are thick, they need every one.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪŋz ɑr θɪk, ðeɪ nid ˈɛvri wʌn/
dialogue.zh: 雞翅厚，每一分鐘都有用。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What are we watching for this time?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌt ɑr wi ˈwɑtʃɪŋ fɔr ðɪs taɪm/
dialogue.zh: 這次我們要觀察什麼？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Bubbling skin, and drips in the tray.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈbʌbəlɪŋ skɪn, ænd drɪps ɪn ðə treɪ/
dialogue.zh: 皮在冒泡，盤子在接油。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hot fat will drip down into the tray.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑt fæt wɪl drɪp daʊn ˈɪntu ðə treɪ/
dialogue.zh: 滾油會一路滴進盤子裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: If it smokes, add one spoon of water.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪf ɪt smoʊks, æd wʌn spun ʌv ˈwɔtɚ/
dialogue.zh: 如果冒煙，就加一匙水進盤子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Nine minutes, time to turn them over.
dialogue.phonetic: /naɪn ˈmɪnɪts, taɪm tu tɜrn ðɛm ˈoʊvɚ/
dialogue.zh: 九分鐘，該把它們翻過來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Pull it out and count to ten first.
dialogue.phonetic: /pʊl ɪt aʊt ænd kaʊnt tu tɛn fɜrst/
dialogue.zh: 先拉出來，數到十再動。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One to ten, now the heat has left.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn tə tɛn, naʊ ðə hit hæz lɛft/
dialogue.zh: 數到十，熱氣已經散了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Now turn each with the wooden spoon.
dialogue.phonetic: /naʊ tɜrn itʃ wɪð ðə ˈwʊdən spun/
dialogue.zh: 現在用木湯匙一隻一隻翻。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It stuck once, the skin grabs the spoon.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt stʌk wʌns, ðə skɪn ɡræbz ðə spun/
dialogue.zh: 有一隻黏住了，皮會抓住湯匙。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Lift slow, it will let go again.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɪft sloʊ, ɪt wɪl lɛt ɡoʊ əˈɡɛn/
dialogue.zh: 慢慢抬，它自己會鬆開。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Turned, the second side is pale.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɜrnd, ðə ˈsɛkənd saɪd ɪz peɪl/
dialogue.zh: 翻好了，第二面還是白的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It will color in nine more minutes.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt wɪl ˈkʌlɚ ɪn naɪn mɔr ˈmɪnɪts/
dialogue.zh: 再九分鐘它就會上色。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Slide it back, did the rail click?
dialogue.phonetic: /slaɪd ɪt bæk, dɪd ðə reɪl klɪk/
dialogue.zh: 滑回去，滑軌咔了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Click, and the hum came back up.
dialogue.phonetic: /klɪk, ænd ðə hʌm keɪm bæk ʌp/
dialogue.zh: 咔，嗡嗡聲又變高了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Juice is turning brown down in the tray.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʒus ɪz ˈtɜrnɪŋ braʊn daʊn ɪn ðə treɪ/
dialogue.zh: 汁在盤子底慢慢變棕色。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That brown juice is the flavor test.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt braʊn dʒus ɪz ðə ˈfleɪvɚ tɛst/
dialogue.zh: 那棕色汁就是味道的考卷。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do not taste it, the juice is raw.
dialogue.phonetic: /du nɑt teɪst ɪt, ðə dʒus ɪz rɔ/
dialogue.zh: 不要嚐那個汁，它還是生的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only the cooked skin later, promise.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈoʊnli ðə kʊkt skɪn ˈleɪtɚ, ˈprɑmɪs/
dialogue.zh: 待會兒只吃烤熟的皮，答應我。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Nine more, and the smell is heavy.
dialogue.phonetic: /naɪn mɔr, ænd ðə smɛl ɪz ˈhɛvi/
dialogue.zh: 再九分鐘，味道變濃了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Heavy and sweet, paprika toasted well.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈhɛvi ænd swit, pəˈprikə ˈtoʊstɪd wɛl/
dialogue.zh: 又濃又甜，紅椒粉烤得好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Our window is fogged from all the steam.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈaʊɚ ˈwɪndoʊ ɪz fɔɡd frʌm ɔl ðə stim/
dialogue.zh: 我們的窗戶被蒸氣霧成一片。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wipe one line, then come sit down.
dialogue.phonetic: /waɪp wʌn laɪn, ðɛn kʌm sɪt daʊn/
dialogue.zh: 擦出一條線，然後過來坐。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Four minutes left, the skin is bubbling.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɔr ˈmɪnɪts lɛft, ðə skɪn ɪz ˈbʌbəlɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 剩四分鐘，皮在冒小泡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Bubbles mean the fat is leaving.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈbʌbəlz min ðə fæt ɪz ˈlivɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 冒泡就代表脂肪正在離開。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Leaving the wing, landing in the tray.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈlivɪŋ ðə wɪŋ, ˈlændɪŋ ɪn ðə treɪ/
dialogue.zh: 離開雞翅，落進盤子裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is why the skin gets crisp.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ɪz waɪ ðə skɪn ɡɛts krɪsp/
dialogue.zh: 這就是皮會變脆的道理。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two minutes, do we shake once more?
dialogue.phonetic: /tu ˈmɪnɪts, du wi ʃeɪk wʌns mɔr/
dialogue.zh: 兩分鐘了，要不要再搖一次？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No shake, wings hate a rough move.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ʃeɪk, wɪŋz heɪt ə rʌf muv/
dialogue.zh: 不要搖，雞翅討厭粗魯的動作。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then hold them still and let them color.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn hoʊld ðɛm stɪl ænd lɛt ðɛm ˈkʌlɚ/
dialogue.zh: 那就讓它們靜靜地變色。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Still, deep red, the timer says one.
dialogue.phonetic: /stɪl, dip rɛd, ðə ˈtaɪmɚ sɛz wʌn/
dialogue.zh: 靜靜的，深紅色，計時剩一。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One minute, then rest them two.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn ˈmɪnɪt, ðɛn rɛst ðɛm tu/
dialogue.zh: 一分鐘，然後讓它們靜置兩分鐘。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Rest keeps the juice inside the meat.
dialogue.phonetic: /rɛst kips ðə dʒus ɪnˈsaɪd ðə mit/
dialogue.zh: 靜置會讓汁留在肉裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Beep, out they go, onto the plate.
dialogue.phonetic: /bip, aʊt ðeɪ ɡoʊ, ˈɑntu ðə pleɪt/
dialogue.zh: 嗶，出爐，放到盤子上。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Careful, the tray is hot and slick.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈkɛrfəl, ðə treɪ ɪz hɑt ænd slɪk/
dialogue.zh: 小心，盤子又燙又滑。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Set the tray on the wet cloth.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɛt ðə treɪ ɑn ðə wɛt klɔθ/
dialogue.zh: 把盤子放在濕布上。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: There it sits, safe, shining red.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛr ɪt sɪts, seɪf, ˈʃaɪnɪŋ rɛd/
dialogue.zh: 它坐好了，安全，亮紅亮紅的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Rest two minutes, then cut one open.
dialogue.phonetic: /rɛst tu ˈmɪnɪts, ðɛn kʌt wʌn ˈoʊpən/
dialogue.zh: 靜置兩分鐘，再切開一隻看。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No pink near the bone, it is done.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ pɪŋk nɪr ðə boʊn, ɪt ɪz dʌn/
dialogue.zh: 骨邊沒有粉紅，熟透了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Look, the bone is clean and white.
dialogue.phonetic: /lʊk, ðə boʊn ɪz klin ænd waɪt/
dialogue.zh: 你看，骨頭乾淨又白。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Juicy, not raw, that is our goal.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈdʒusɪ, nɑt rɔ, ðæt ɪz ˈaʊɚ ɡoʊl/
dialogue.zh: 多汁又不生，那就是我們的目標。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Lemon on the wings, or hot sauce?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈlɛmən ɑn ðə wɪŋz, ɔr hɑt sɔs/
dialogue.zh: 雞翅上要檸檬還是辣醬？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Lemon for me, sauce within reach.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈlɛmən fɔr mi, sɔs wɪˈðɪn ritʃ/
dialogue.zh: 檸檬給我，辣醬放在拿得到的地方。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A tiny dish for the red sauce.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ˈtaɪni dɪʃ fɔr ðə rɛd sɔs/
dialogue.zh: 一個小碟子裝紅色辣醬。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two dips, one for each of us.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu dɪps, wʌn fɔr itʃ ʌv ʌs/
dialogue.zh: 兩份沾醬，一人一個。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Salt again? The wings look calm.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɔlt əˈɡɛn? ðə wɪŋz lʊk kɑm/
dialogue.zh: 再撒鹽嗎？雞翅看起來夠味道了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A light shake of salt, then eat.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə laɪt ʃeɪk ʌv sɔlt, ðɛn it/
dialogue.zh: 輕輕搖一點鹽，然後開動。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One bite, wow, the skin did crack.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn baɪt, waʊ, ðə skɪn dɪd kræk/
dialogue.zh: 咬一口，哇，皮真的裂了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Crack outside, soft inside, perfect.
dialogue.phonetic: /kræk ˌaʊtˈsaɪd, sɔft ɪnˈsaɪd, ˈpɜrfɪkt/
dialogue.zh: 外面脆、裡面軟，完美。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Three each, and two more for tomorrow.
dialogue.phonetic: /θri itʃ, ænd tu mɔr fɔr təˈmɑroʊ/
dialogue.zh: 一人三隻，留兩隻明天吃。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wrap them, fridge, and they reheat well.
dialogue.phonetic: /ræp ðɛm, frɪdʒ, ænd ðeɪ ˌriˈhit wɛl/
dialogue.zh: 包起來冰著，明天回熱也不壞。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Three minutes to reheat, not more.
dialogue.phonetic: /θri ˈmɪnɪts tu ˌriˈhit, nɑt mɔr/
dialogue.zh: 回熱三分鐘，不要更多。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Same basket, same heat, no preheat needed.
dialogue.phonetic: /seɪm ˈbæskət, seɪm hit, noʊ ˈpriˌhɪt ˈnidəd/
dialogue.zh: 同一個炸籃、同一個溫度，不用預熱。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No preheat tomorrow, that is easy.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ˈpriˌhɪt təˈmɑroʊ, ðæt ɪz ˈizi/
dialogue.zh: 明天不用預熱，真輕鬆。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You are becoming the basket boss.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju ɑr bɪˈkomɪŋ ðə ˈbæskət bɔs/
dialogue.zh: 你快要變成炸籃的老闆了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Boss of one small air fryer, surely.
dialogue.phonetic: /bɔs ʌv wʌn smɔl ɛr ˈfraɪər, ˈʃʊrli/
dialogue.zh: 當然，只是一個小氣炸鍋的老闆。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Enough for tonight, the wings are gone.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪˈnʌf fɔr təˈnaɪt, ðə wɪŋz ɑr ɡɔn/
dialogue.zh: 今晚夠了，雞翅都吃光了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Six gone, two wait inside the foil.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɪks ɡɑn, tu weɪt ɪnˈsaɪd ðə fɔɪl/
dialogue.zh: 六隻吃光了，兩隻包在鋁箔裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Three bones on your plate, I counted.
dialogue.phonetic: /θri boʊnz ɑn jɔr pleɪt, aɪ ˈkaʊntɪd/
dialogue.zh: 你盤裡有三根骨頭，我數過。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Our wings were a real second try.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈaʊɚ wɪŋz wɜr ə ril ˈsɛkənd traɪ/
dialogue.zh: 我們的雞翅是名副其實的第二輪。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Better than the fries, honestly.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈbɛtɚ ðæn ðə fraɪz, ˈɑnəstli/
dialogue.zh: 老實說，比薯條好吃。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And none of them came out pale.
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd nʌn ʌv ðɔm keɪm aʊt peɪl/
dialogue.zh: 而且這一回沒有一隻是白的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wings forgive a wet basket more.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪŋz fɚˈɡiv ə wɛt ˈbæskət mɔr/
dialogue.zh: 雞翅比較不挑濕的炸籃。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Because wings bring their own fat.
dialogue.phonetic: /bɪˈkɔz wɪŋz brɪŋ ðɛr oʊn fæt/
dialogue.zh: 因為雞翅自己帶著油。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And they are thick, they hold heat.
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd ðeɪ ɑr θɪk, ðeɪ hoʊld hit/
dialogue.zh: 而且它們厚，留得住熱。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I am glad we tried wings tonight.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ æm ɡlæd wi traɪd wɪŋz təˈnaɪt/
dialogue.zh: 我很高興我們今晚烤了雞翅。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Glad, and tired, the clock says late.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡlæd, ænd ˈtaɪərd, ðə klɑk sɛz leɪt/
dialogue.zh: 高興也累了，時鐘說晚了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Late, but the basket still needs washing.
dialogue.phonetic: /leɪt, bʌt ðə ˈbæskət stɪl nidz ˈwɑʃɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 晚了，但炸籃還是要洗。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It must cool first, ten full minutes.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt mʌst kul fɜrst, tɛn fʊl ˈmɪnɪts/
dialogue.zh: 它要先涼十整分鐘。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So we wait, and we talk a little.
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ wi weɪt, ænd wi tɔk ə ˈlɪtəl/
dialogue.zh: 那我們邊等邊聊天。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: About tomorrow, and the clean basket.
dialogue.phonetic: /əˈbaʊt təˈmɑroʊ, ænd ðə klin ˈbæskət/
dialogue.zh: 聊明天，還有洗乾淨的炸籃。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Cool basket first, then the sponge.
dialogue.phonetic: /kul ˈbæskət fɜrst, ðɛn ðə spʌndʒ/
dialogue.zh: 先讓炸籃涼，才輪到海綿。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then the towel, then the shelf, good night.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn ðə ˈtaʊəl, ðɛn ðə ʃɛlf, ɡʊd naɪt/
dialogue.zh: 再來是毛巾，再歸位，晚安。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Basket is still warm, leave it be.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈbæskɪt ɪz stɪl wɔrm liv ɪt bi/
dialogue.zh: 炸籃還溫溫的，先別碰它。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We can wait ten minutes, no rush.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi kæn weɪt tɛn ˈmɪnɪts noʊ rʌʃ/
dialogue.zh: 我們可以等十分鐘，不用趕。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Unplug the cord from the wall first.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˌʌnˈplɛɡ ðə kɔrd frʌm ðə wɔl fɜrst/
dialogue.zh: 先從牆上把插頭拔下來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Loop it twice around the fryer base.
dialogue.phonetic: /lup ɪt twaɪs əˈraʊnd ðə ˈfraɪər beɪs/
dialogue.zh: 在鍋底纏兩圈就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Grease in the tray, wipe it out.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡris ɪn ðə treɪ waɪp ɪt aʊt/
dialogue.zh: 底盤有油，先擦掉。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Paper towels work, then toss the paper.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpeɪpɚ ˈtaʊəlz wɜrk ðɛn tɑs ðə ˈpeɪpɚ/
dialogue.zh: 紙巾就可以，用完再丟掉。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Warm water, not scalding, fills the sink.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɔrm ˈwɔtɚ nɑt ˈskɑldɪŋ fɪlz ðə sɪŋk/
dialogue.zh: 溫水，不要滾水，裝進水槽。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two drops of dish soap, no more.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu drɑps ʌv dɪʃ soʊp noʊ mɔr/
dialogue.zh: 洗碗精兩滴就好，不要多。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Basket goes in mesh side down.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈbæskɪt ɡoʊz ɪn mɛʃ saɪd daʊn/
dialogue.zh: 炸籃放進水裡，網面朝下。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sticky bits need two quiet minutes to soak.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈstɪki bɪts nid tu ˈkwaɪət ˈmɪnɪts tu soʊk/
dialogue.zh: 黏住的屑屑要靜靜泡兩分鐘。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Page sixteen said soft sponge only.
dialogue.phonetic: /peɪdʒ ˌsɪksˈtin sɛd sɔft spʌndʒ ˈoʊnli/
dialogue.zh: 第十六頁交代只能用軟海綿。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Scratch the coating and the basket is ruined.
dialogue.phonetic: /skrætʃ ðə ˈkoʊtɪŋ ænd ðə ˈbæskɪt ɪz ruˈɪnd/
dialogue.zh: 刮傷防黏層，炸籃就壞掉了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Gentle circles, that is all it takes.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈdʒɛntəl ˈsɜrkəlz ðæt ɪz ɔl ɪt teɪks/
dialogue.zh: 輕輕打圈，這樣就夠了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Rinse it under the running warm tap.
dialogue.phonetic: /rɪns ɪt ˈʌndɚ ðə ˈrʌnɪŋ wɔrm tæp/
dialogue.zh: 放到溫水龍頭下沖乾淨。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Shake twice, keep the water in the sink.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃeɪk twaɪs kip ðə ˈwɔtɚ ɪn ðə sɪŋk/
dialogue.zh: 搖兩下，水留在水槽裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Gray towel now, the one for grease.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡreɪ ˈtaʊəl naʊ ðə wʌn fɔr ɡris/
dialogue.zh: 現在用灰色那條布，專門擦油的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Water spots on the mesh, dry them well.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈwɔtɚ spɑts ɑn ðə mɛʃ draɪ ðɛm wɛl/
dialogue.zh: 網眼裡有水珠，要擦乾。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The towel gets into every little square.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈtaʊəl ɡɛts ˈɪntu ˈɛvri ˈlɪtəl skwɛr/
dialogue.zh: 毛巾的角能伸進每個小格子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Check the handle too, grease hides there.
dialogue.phonetic: /tʃɛk ðə ˈhændəl tu ɡris haɪdz ðɛr/
dialogue.zh: 手把也要檢查，油都藏在那裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, handle and rim, both dried now.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ˈhændəl ænd rɪm boʊθ draɪd naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 對，手把和邊框都擦乾了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Even the air holes need a dry corner.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈivən ðə ɛr hoʊlz nid ə draɪ ˈkɔrnɚ/
dialogue.zh: 連透氣孔都要用布的乾角擦。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wipe the outside, never pour water in.
dialogue.phonetic: /waɪp ðə ˌaʊtˈsaɪd ˈnɛvɚ pɔr ˈwɔtɚ ɪn/
dialogue.zh: 外面用布擦，千萬別倒水進去。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Heating part at the top, cloth only.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈhidɪŋ pɑrt æt ðə tɑp klɔθ ˈoʊnli/
dialogue.zh: 上方那個加熱器，只能用布擦。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Fryer body wiped, no soap on it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈfraɪər ˈbɑdi waɪpt noʊ soʊp ɑn ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 鍋身擦過了，上面不沾洗碗精。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Just a damp cloth, wrung out tight.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʒʌst ə dæmp klɔθ rʌŋ aʊt taɪt/
dialogue.zh: 只是一塊絞得很乾的濕布。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Hold the basket up, you can see it shine.
dialogue.phonetic: /hoʊld ðə ˈbæskɪt ʌp ju kæn si ɪt ʃaɪn/
dialogue.zh: 把炸籃舉高看看，它發亮了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Set it upside down on the dish rack.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɛt ɪt ˈʌpsaɪd daʊn ɑn ðə dɪʃ ræk/
dialogue.zh: 倒扣放在瀝水架上。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One hour of air, then it is stored.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn ˈaʊɚ ʌv ɛr ðɛn ɪt ɪz stɔrd/
dialogue.zh: 風乾一小時，再收起來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wait five, the base is still warm.
dialogue.phonetic: /weɪt faɪv ðə beɪs ɪz stɪl wɔrm/
dialogue.zh: 等五分鐘，鍋底還溫溫的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two hands now, it is not heavy.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu hændz naʊ ɪt ɪz nɑt ˈhɛvi/
dialogue.zh: 現在用兩手搬，它並不重。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sponge rinsed and hung on its hook.
dialogue.phonetic: /spʌndʒ rɪnst ænd hʌŋ ɑn ɪts hʊk/
dialogue.zh: 海綿沖乾淨，掛回它的掛鉤。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sink emptied, the gray water is gone.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɪŋk ˈɛmptid ðə ɡreɪ ˈwɔtɚ ɪz ɡɑn/
dialogue.zh: 水槽清空了，濁水也不見了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Empty tray washed, it is spotless now.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɛmpti treɪ wɑʃt ɪt ɪz ˈspɑtləs naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 底盤也洗好了，現在沒有痕跡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Settle everything, we are nearly done.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsɛtəl ˈɛvriθɪŋ wi ɑr ˈnɪrli dʌn/
dialogue.zh: 每樣東西歸位，我們快好了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Trash bag tied, the plastic goes out.
dialogue.phonetic: /træʃ bæɡ taɪd, ðə ˈplæstɪk ɡoʊz aʊt/
dialogue.zh: 垃圾袋綁好，塑膠袋拿去丟。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Cardboard stays flat under the sink.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈkɑrdˌbɔrd steɪz flæt ˈʌndɚ ðə sɪŋk/
dialogue.zh: 紙板壓平留在水槽下面。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Scissors back where the scissors live.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsɪsɚz bæk wɛr ðə ˈsɪsɚz lɪv/
dialogue.zh: 剪刀放回它本來的位置。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Top drawer, left corner, done.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɑp drɔr lɛft ˈkɔrnɚ dʌn/
dialogue.zh: 最上層抽屜，左邊角落。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Spray bottle goes back in the cabinet.
dialogue.phonetic: /spreɪ ˈbɑtəl ɡoʊz bæk ɪn ðə ˈkæbɪnɪt/
dialogue.zh: 噴油瓶放回廚櫃裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Label facing out, so we spot it fast.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈleɪbəl ˈfeɪsɪŋ aʊt, soʊ wi spɑt ɪt fæst/
dialogue.zh: 標籤朝外，一眼就找得到。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Label the bag, write air fryer on it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈleɪbəl ðə bæɡ raɪt ɛr ˈfraɪər ɑn ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 在袋子上寫氣炸鍋三個字。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nothing to hunt for next week.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈnʌθɪŋ tu hʌnt fɔr nɛkst wik/
dialogue.zh: 下週就不用到處亂找了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The paper manual goes into the zip bag.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈpeɪpɚ ˈmænjuəl ɡoʊz ˈɪntu ðə zɪp bæɡ/
dialogue.zh: 說明書放進夾鏈袋裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Bag sealed, the pages stay flat.
dialogue.phonetic: /bæɡ silk ðə ˈpeɪdʒɪz steɪ flæt/
dialogue.zh: 袋子封起來，頁面就不會皺。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Leftover wings, we wrap them in foil.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈlɛftˌoʊvɚ wɪŋz wi ræp ðɛm ɪn fɔɪl/
dialogue.zh: 吃剩的雞翅，用鋁箔包起來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Into the fridge, top shelf, not the door.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɪntu ðə frɪdʒ tɑp ʃɛlf nɑt ðə dɔr/
dialogue.zh: 放進冰箱上層，不要放門邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Tomorrow, three minutes, no warm up.
dialogue.phonetic: /təˈmɑroʊ θri ˈmɪnɪts noʊ wɔrm ʌp/
dialogue.zh: 明天回熱三分鐘，不用預熱。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Write that note on the fridge card.
dialogue.phonetic: /raɪt ðæt noʊt ɑn ðə frɪdʒ kɑrd/
dialogue.zh: 把這條記在冰箱上的小卡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Four minutes extra, single layer, two lines.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɔr ˈmɪnɪts ˈɛkstrə ˈsɪŋɡəl ˈleɪɚ tu laɪnz/
dialogue.zh: 多四分鐘、只鋪一層，寫兩行。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Note about crowding, we learned it.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊt əˈbaʊt ˈkraʊdɪŋ wi lɜrnd ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 塞太滿這一條，我們學會了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Too many fries make soft fries.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu ˈmɛni fraɪz meɪk sɔft fraɪz/
dialogue.zh: 薯條堆太多只會變軟。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Pat dry first, that is the trick.
dialogue.phonetic: /pæt draɪ fɜrst ðæt ɪz ðə trɪk/
dialogue.zh: 先把表面壓乾，這就是訣竅。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wet skin never turns golden brown.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛt skɪn ˈnɛvɚ tɜrnz ˈɡoʊldən braʊn/
dialogue.zh: 濕濕的表皮永遠不會金黃。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Second round was the better round.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsɛkənd raʊnd wʌz ðə ˈbɛtɚ raʊnd/
dialogue.zh: 第二鍋比第一鍋還要好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wings beat fries, I will say that.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪŋz bit fraɪz aɪ wɪl seɪ ðæt/
dialogue.zh: 雞翅贏過薯條，我這樣講。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: But Saturday we try the fries again.
dialogue.phonetic: /bʌt ˈsætɚdeɪ, wi traɪ ðə fraɪz əˈɡɛn/
dialogue.zh: 不過週六我們再來挑戰薯條。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thinner cut, fewer pieces, four more minutes.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈθɪnɚ kʌt ˈfjuɚ ˈpisɪz fɔr mɔr ˈmɪnɪts/
dialogue.zh: 切細一點、少放一點、多四分鐘。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Counter wiped, crumbs swept into the bin.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈkaʊntɚ waɪpt krʌmz swɛpt ˈɪntu ðə bɪn/
dialogue.zh: 流理台擦過了，屑屑掃進垃圾桶。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hands washed with soap, dried on the towel.
dialogue.phonetic: /hændz wɑʃt wɪð soʊp draɪd ɑn ðə ˈtaʊəl/
dialogue.zh: 用肥皂洗了手，再用毛巾擦乾。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Hands smell of lemon soap, nice.
dialogue.phonetic: /hændz smɛl ʌv ˈlɛmən soʊp naɪs/
dialogue.zh: 手上有檸檬肥皂的香氣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Paper, towel, sponge, all back in place.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpeɪpɚ ˈtaʊəl spʌndʒ ɔl bæk ɪn pleɪs/
dialogue.zh: 衛生紙、抹布、海綿都收好了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Basket bone dry, so it goes back in.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈbæskɪt boʊn draɪ soʊ ɪt ɡoʊz bæk ɪn/
dialogue.zh: 炸籃完全乾了，所以放回去。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Push until it clicks, that is right.
dialogue.phonetic: /pʊʃ ʌnˈtɪl ɪt klɪks ðæt ɪz raɪt/
dialogue.zh: 推到咔的一聲，那樣就對了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Drawer glides shut with no noise left.
dialogue.phonetic: /drɔr ɡlaɪdz ʃʌt wɪð noʊ nɔɪz lɛft/
dialogue.zh: 抽屜無聲地滑上，沒有雜音。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Quiet machine, quiet kitchen, quiet night.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈkwaɪət məˈʃin ˈkwaɪət ˈkɪtʃɪn ˈkwaɪət naɪt/
dialogue.zh: 安靜的鍋、安靜的廚房、安靜的夜晚。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Shelf cleared, the mat goes down first.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃɛlf klɪrd ðə mæt ɡoʊz daʊn fɜrst/
dialogue.zh: 架子先清空，墊子放最下面。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Non slip mat, then the fryer sits.
dialogue.phonetic: /nɑn slɪp mæt ðɛn ðə ˈfraɪər sɪts/
dialogue.zh: 鋪好防滑墊，氣炸鍋才站得穩。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Slide it back, leave space at the wall.
dialogue.phonetic: /slaɪd ɪt bæk liv speɪs æt ðə wɔl/
dialogue.zh: 往裡面推，牆邊留個空隙。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Air needs room, the manual says that.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɛr nidz rum ðə ˈmænjuəl sɛz ðæt/
dialogue.zh: 散熱要有空間，說明書這樣寫。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Fryer sits clean on the cleared shelf.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈfraɪər sɪts klin ɑn ðə klɪrd ʃɛlf/
dialogue.zh: 氣炸鍋乾淨地站在清空的層架上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Saturday we make the thin sweet potato strips.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsætɚdeɪ wi meɪk ðə θɪn swit pəˈteɪtoʊ strɪps/
dialogue.zh: 週六來做細細的地瓜條。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, and a dry basket, no wet starch.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ænd ə draɪ ˈbæskɪt noʊ wɛt stɑrtʃ/
dialogue.zh: 好，還要擦乾炸籃，不能帶澱粉水。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two cards on the fridge, we are ready.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu kɑrdz ɑn ðə frɪdʒ wi ɑr ˈrɛdi/
dialogue.zh: 冰箱上貼了兩張卡，我們準備好了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Kitchen light off, leave the hall one on.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈkɪtʃɪn laɪt ɔf liv ðə hɔl wʌn ɑn/
dialogue.zh: 廚房燈關掉，走廊那盞留著。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My fingers still smell like smoked paprika.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ ˈfɪŋɡɚz stɪl smɛl laɪk smoʊkt pəˈpriːkə/
dialogue.zh: 我的手指還有一點煙燻椒的味道。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Mine taste of lemon and hot sauce.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪn teɪst ʌv ˈlɛmən ænd hɑt sɔs/
dialogue.zh: 我的嚐起來是檸檬加辣醬。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Crispy skin, juicy middle, worth the wait.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈkrɪspi skɪn ˈdʒusi ˈmɪdəl wɜrθ ðə weɪt/
dialogue.zh: 外皮酥脆，裡面多汁，等得值得。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nothing loud now, just a quiet kitchen.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈnʌθɪŋ laʊd naʊ dʒʌst ə ˈkwaɪət ˈkɪtʃɪn/
dialogue.zh: 現在沒有聲音了，廚房很安靜。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Bed soon, but one fryer question first.
dialogue.phonetic: /bɛd sun bʌt wʌn ˈfraɪər ˈkwɛstʃən fɜrst/
dialogue.zh: 馬上就睡了，不過先問一個問題。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Was it the shake that made them crisp?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌz ɪt ðə ʃeɪk ðæt meɪd ðɛm krɪsp/
dialogue.zh: 是搖晃讓它們變脆的嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No, the dry skin and the hot air.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ðə draɪ skɪn ænd ðə hɑt ɛr/
dialogue.zh: 不是，是擦乾的皮和滾燙的風。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then write that on the card too.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn raɪt ðæt ɑn ðə kɑrd tu/
dialogue.zh: 那也把這條寫在卡片上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So we find it fast next time.
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ wi faɪnd ɪt fæst nɛkst taɪm/
dialogue.zh: 這樣下次馬上就能翻到。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Teeth brushed, water, and that is it.
dialogue.phonetic: /tiː brʌʃt ˈwɔtɚ ænd ðæt ɪz ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 牙刷好了，喝口水，就這樣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Switch off the lamp, leave the small one.
dialogue.phonetic: /swɪtʃ ɔf ðə læmp liv ðə smɔl wʌn/
dialogue.zh: 關掉台燈，小夜燈留著。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tomorrow morning that foil bag is ours.
dialogue.phonetic: /təˈmɑroʊ ˈmɔrnɪŋ ðæt fɔɪl bæɡ ɪz ˈaʊɚz/
dialogue.zh: 明天早上那包鋁箔就是我們的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Chin covered, cool pillow turned outward.
dialogue.phonetic: /tʃɪn ˈkʌvərd kul ˈpɪloʊ tɜrnd ˈaʊtwərd/
dialogue.zh: 下巴蓋好了，枕頭轉到涼的那面。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Done, and now the blanket and the dark.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌn ænd naʊ ðə ˈblæŋkɪt ænd ðə dɑrk/
dialogue.zh: 做完了，現在是毯子和黑暗。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Breathing slow now, nothing left to do.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈbriðɪŋ sloʊ naʊ ˈnʌθɪŋ lɛft tu du/
dialogue.zh: 現在呼吸慢慢的，沒有事要做了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Everything washed, everything dried, everything stored.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɛvriθɪŋ wɑʃt ˈɛvriθɪŋ draɪd ˈɛvriθɪŋ stɔrd/
dialogue.zh: 全都洗了，全都擦乾，全都收了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hum of the fridge, that is all.
dialogue.phonetic: /hʌm ʌv ðə frɪdʒ ðæt ɪz ɔl/
dialogue.zh: 只有冰箱的嗡嗡聲，就這些。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Softest sound in this whole house.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsɔftɪst saʊnd ɪn ðɪs hoʊl haʊs/
dialogue.zh: 這是這間房子最輕的聲音。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Eyes closed, the kitchen stays behind us.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪz kloʊzd ðə ˈkɪtʃɪn steɪz bɪˈhaɪnd ʌs/
dialogue.zh: 閉上眼睛，廚房留在我們身後。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sleep comes easy after a slow night.
dialogue.phonetic: /slip kʌmz ˈizi ˈæftɚ ə sloʊ naɪt/
dialogue.zh: 慢慢的一夜之後，很好入睡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good night to the clean air fryer.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd naɪt tu ðə klin ɛr ˈfraɪər/
dialogue.zh: 跟乾淨的氣炸鍋說晚安。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sleep first, we cook again on Saturday.
dialogue.phonetic: /slip fɜrst wi kʊk əˈɡɛn ɑn ˈsætɚdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 先睡吧，週六我們再煮一次。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, Saturday morning, one small batch.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, ˈsætɚdeɪ ˈmɔrnɪŋ, wʌn smɔl bætʃ/
dialogue.zh: 對，週六早上，先做一小鍋。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One small batch, then a long walk.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn smɔl bætʃ ðɛn ə lɔŋ wɔk/
dialogue.zh: 一小鍋，然後出門走一走。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hall light on, the door is ajar.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɔl laɪt ɑn ðə dɔr ɪz əˈdʒɑr/
dialogue.zh: 走廊的燈亮著，門就這樣開著。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Just a crack, and the hallway glow.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʒʌst ə kræk ænd ðə ˈhɔlˌweɪ ɡloʊ/
dialogue.zh: 只留一條縫，和走廊的微光。
